programme.title: DW English News
programme.desc: News and analysis of the top international and European news and current affairs from Berlin, in English.

programme.title: DW Euromaxx
programme.desc: Magazine programs Euromaxx, Sports Life and other features as broadcast by DW News in Berlin, Germany.

programme.title: PBS News Horizons
programme.desc: Dive into the world of science, health, technology and environmental issues making headlines each week, hosted by PBS News Hour's William Brangham.

programme.title: France 24 English News
programme.desc: International news and current affairs television from Paris, offering a French perspective on world events, in English.

programme.title: Rancho Deluxe
programme.desc: Cattle rustlers Jack McKee (Jeff Bridges) and Cecil Colson (Sam Waterston) steadily steal cows from wealthy rancher John Brown (Clifton James). When his two hapless ranch hands (Harry Dean Stanton, Richard Bright) fail at capturing the thieves, Brown calls upon the services of Henry Beige (Slim Pickens), a cattle rustler turned detective -- although Beige does little more than sit around all day. But as they continue to get away with their crimes, McKee and Colson become a little too confident.

programme.title: Billy Two Hats
programme.desc: After a bank robbery goes wrong, outlaw Billy Two Hats (Desi Arnaz Jr.) is captured by Sheriff Gifford (Jack Warden). Billy's partner, Arch Deans (Gregory Peck), rescues him, but during the escape Deans gets shot in the leg. The wound leaves Deans unable to ride a horse, but Billy refuses to leave him behind. Instead, he builds a horse-drawn cot for him, and they continue together. The apparatus slows them down, however, making them even more vulnerable to capture from the pursuing sheriff.

programme.title: Stagecoach
programme.desc: An outlaw (Kris Kristofferson), a gambler (Waylon Jennings), Doc Holliday (Willie Nelson) and other passengers have Geronimo's war party for company.

programme.title: Death Valley Rangers
programme.desc: The Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson, Bob Steele) catch hijackers of stagecoach gold shipments.

programme.title: The Steel Lady
programme.desc: Four gold seekers trapped in the desert by Arabs attempt to escape via an old German tank that they discover.

programme.title: Comanche
programme.desc: Renegade Comanche leader Black Cloud (Henry Brandon) attacks a Mexican village and kidnaps the beautiful Margarita Alvarez (Linda Cristal). Fleeing to the United States, they come across a band of scalp hunters and are prevented from massacring them by the Comanche chief of the Antelope tribe, Quanah (Kent Smith). Despite the efforts of frontier scout Jim Read (Dana Andrews), turmoil erupts between the whites and the rebel Comanche, and Quanah and Read struggle to restore peace.

programme.title: Gunsight Ridge
programme.desc: Gunslinger Mike Ryan (Joel McCrea) is intent on bringing the dangerous outlaw Velvet Clark (Mark Stevens) to justice. However, Ryan is at a disadvantage, since he doesn't know what the masked robber looks like. Ryan begins to work with the area sheriff and falls for the lawman's pretty daughter, Molly Jones (Joan Weldon). With Clark hiding in plain sight as a piano player, the criminal manages to evade Ryan for a while, but eventually the two adversaries come face-to-face.

programme.title: Robbers' Roost
programme.desc: An outlaw attempting to go straight while tracking down one of his wife's killers, Jim "Tex" Wall (George Montgomery) finds work on a ranch operated by disabled cattle owner "Bull" Herrick (Bruce Bennett). As Tex begins to fall for Bull's pretty sister, Helen (Sylvia Findley), he also has to face off against two feuding gangs of rustlers, one led by the tough Heesman (Peter Graves). Can Tex escape his shady past and finally end his mission of vengeance?

programme.title: Outlaw Trail
programme.desc: Banking mogul "Honest John" Travers (Cy Kendall) is using methods both illegal and immoral to monopolize the economy of Johnstown, a Western outpost. When businessman Carl Beldon (George Eldredge) comes to Johnstown looking to make a deal with local ranchers rather than Travers, he suddenly goes missing. U.S. marshals Gibson (Hoot Gibson) and Steele (Bob Steele) are then called in to search for Beldon, but as they investigate they find themselves shadowed by a deadly gang employed by Travers.

programme.title: Another Man, Another Chance
programme.desc: When Jeanne (Geneviève Bujold), a young woman, falls for a photographer named Francis (Francis Huster), he convinces her to leave war-torn France and move to America with him. After they have set up a photography shop and have a baby, Francis dies. A few years later, Jeanne meets David (James Caan), a the solitary man who cannot forget the murder of his wife. Jeanne and David start a relationship, but she worries that his dangerous search for his wife's killers threatens their love.

programme.title: Rancho Deluxe
programme.desc: Cattle rustlers Jack McKee (Jeff Bridges) and Cecil Colson (Sam Waterston) steadily steal cows from wealthy rancher John Brown (Clifton James). When his two hapless ranch hands (Harry Dean Stanton, Richard Bright) fail at capturing the thieves, Brown calls upon the services of Henry Beige (Slim Pickens), a cattle rustler turned detective -- although Beige does little more than sit around all day. But as they continue to get away with their crimes, McKee and Colson become a little too confident.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: L'enlèvement d'un adolescent mène l'équipe à un membre de la Marine américaine ayant survécu à une prise d'otages par des talibans; l'agent en question aurait cependant possiblement commis un meurtre à son retour aux États-Unis; pendant ce temps, Jimmy partage enfin à son patron ses découvertes concernant la mort mystérieuse de la mère de Parker.

programme.title: Esprits brillants
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une entraîneuse de basketball de lycée est confrontée à une maladie débilitante, Dr Wolf doit aider sa patiente à se reconnecter à son corps avant qu'il ne soit trop tard ; Ericka et Dana traitent un étudiant qui voit des dragons.

programme.title: Boston Blue
programme.desc: Danny et Lena voient leurs rôles s'inverser d'une manière complètement inattendue; pendant ce temps, Sarah est confrontée à un dilemme personnel qui ébranle sa confiance; Mae ressent beaucoup de pression entourant un dossier politique; Sean et Jonah font une découverte surprenante lors d'une enquête de routine.

programme.title: Ghosts: fantômes à la maison
programme.desc: Jay s'attire les foudres d'un restaurateur local en utilisant pour son restaurant une recette de sauce arrabbiata léguée par Pete; pendant ce temps, Hetty convainc Flower d'emménager dans la chambre de Thor et Trevor; Trevor menace alors de s'installer dans celle de Hetty.

programme.title: Ghosts: fantômes à la maison
programme.desc: Jay devient complètement obsédé par le succès qu'obtient un autre chef de restaurant; Isaac lui raconte alors sa propre histoire de rivalité avec Alexander Hamilton; pendant ce temps, Elias Woodstone revient de l'enfer avec une proposition pour les fantômes; mais attention, cette offre est d'une durée limitée.

programme.title: The Gold: le casse du siècle
programme.desc: On rencontre un Anglais à l'allure formidable, Charlie Miller, dans une luxueuse villa de la Méditerranée; de retour en Angleterre, Brian Boyce, chef de l'équipe spéciale chargée d'enquêter sur le vol de Brink's-Mat, interroge John Palmer.

programme.title: Sheriff Country: shérif sur appel
programme.desc: Un cadavre est découvert en bordure de la rivière; Mickey et son équipe mènent une enquête qui bouleverse grandement tous les habitants de la ville; pendant ce temps, Wes est prêt à tout afin de découvrir la vérité sur ce meurtre.

programme.title: Nuit blanche
programme.desc: En 1980: célèbre mannequin, Louise renoue avec son ancienne voisine Jacinthe; le Québec est en pleine campagne pour l'indépendance de la province, mais le référendum se solde par un échec; Louise et Jacinthe se permettent de rêver grand.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: Amy accepte de laisser Logan prendre en charge le cheval d'un nouveau client ; Tim est furieux et veut s'en prendre à la personne responsable de l'accident de Jack ; pendant ce temps, Lou a du mal à renouer avec Katie.

programme.title: Moonshine
programme.desc: Gale et son gang de motards imposent leur présence au Moonshine; se voyant ainsi engagés dans une guerre de territoire, les membres de la famille Finley-Cullen n'ont d'autre choix que de libérer leur ennemie jurée de prison.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un officier de la marine est retrouvé mort sur une route de campagne, le NCIS doit déterminer si le meurtre est lié au fait qu'il en savait trop sur l'agression d'une de ses collègues.

programme.title: Détectives privés
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un chef de renommée est trouvé mort dans son appartement, Shade et Angie sont engagés par une vieille amie et la nouvelle partenaire du chef afin d'élucider son meurtre.

programme.title: Blue Bloods
programme.desc: Joe Hill poursuit sa mission d'infiltration en collaboration avec le Bureau de l'alcool, du tabac, des armes à feu et des explosifs.

programme.title: Moonshine
programme.desc: Gale et son gang de motards imposent leur présence au Moonshine; se voyant ainsi engagés dans une guerre de territoire, les membres de la famille Finley-Cullen n'ont d'autre choix que de libérer leur ennemie jurée de prison.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Torres rompt audacieusement le protocole quand il apprend qu'un témoin dans une affaire du NCIS est recherché par l'immigration.

programme.title: Annie & Joey
programme.desc: Annie et Joey tissent une relation de plus en plus solide, même si leur premier baiser se fait attendre ; responsable de l'organisation de la fête de la moisson avec Jade, Joey aimerait qu'Annie y participe avec sa troupe de théâtre.

programme.title: Poker Face
programme.desc: Charlie se lie d'amitié avec un artiste doué en effets spéciaux; son atelier est rempli de créatures, de monstres et d'objets miniatures utilisés au cinéma; son nouvel ami fuit un passé douloureux, mais Charlie l'encourage à tourner la page.

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: MacGyver et Desi montent à bord d'un avion en plein vol; le pilote du petit appareil privé a eu une crise cardiaque et son jeune fils, présent à bord avec lui, est en état de panique; on se demande si son arrêt cardiaque était intentionnel.

programme.title: I, Robot
programme.desc: In 2035, highly intelligent robots fill public service positions throughout the world, operating under three rules to keep humans safe. Despite his dark history with robotics, Detective Del Spooner (Will Smith) investigates the alleged suicide of U.S. Robotics founder Alfred Lanning (James Cromwell) and believes that a human-like robot (Alan Tudyk) murdered him. With the help of a robot expert (Bridget Moynahan), Spooner discovers a conspiracy that may enslave the human race.

programme.title: The Fifth Element
programme.desc: The Earth is about to be destroyed by a huge ball of fire racing toward the planet. Cornelius, an old monk, knows how to stop the burning sphere with the help of Korben Dallas, a taxi driver and former secret agent and a woman named Leeloo.

programme.title: The Forever Purge
programme.desc: Adela and her husband, Juan, live in Texas, where he works as a ranch hand for the wealthy Tucker family. Juan impresses the Tucker patriarch, Caleb, but that fuels the jealous anger of his son, Dylan. On the morning after the Purge, a masked gang of killers attacks the Tuckers, forcing both families to band together and fight back as the country spirals into chaos.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: After napalm is detected at a crime scene, the team investigates the sole casualty for possible links to terrorism.

programme.title: Saving Hope
programme.desc: Alex races to find an organ replacement; Joel helps a couple; Charlie is pushed to his breaking point.

programme.title: Saving Hope
programme.desc: An elderly patient believes she's living in a different time; Charlie and Joel get competitive; Maggie is forced to take the reins during a surgery.

programme.title: Saving Hope
programme.desc: Alex is diagnosed with an irregular heartbeat but must care for the Great Randall; Charlie deals with the aftermath of the fight; one of the staff is attacked.

programme.title: Saving Hope
programme.desc: Dr. Alex Reid has a profound experience and Charlie and Dawn try to save her life; Joel's duty is tested by a suicidal patient; Maggie's decision changes her relationship with Gavin.

programme.title: Saving Hope
programme.desc: Alex's spirit goes on a journey with Charlie; Joel be-friends a drug addict; the new OB/GYN throws Maggie off her game.

programme.title: Saving Hope
programme.desc: A crisis at the hospital jogs Alex's memory; a building collapse forces Charlie and Joel to work together; the doctors try to give Maggie some advice.

programme.title: Saving Hope
programme.desc: Alex meets her "buddy colleague" upon returning to work; Joel gets involved in a deadly situation; an unlikely ally helps Gavin.

programme.title: Troy
programme.desc: While visiting Spartan King Menelaus, Trojan prince Paris falls for Menelaus' wife, Helen and takes her back to Troy. Menelaus' brother, King Agamemnon, having already defeated every army in Greece, uses his brother's fury as a pretext to declare war against Troy, the last kingdom preventing his control over the Aegean Sea.

In 480 B.C. a state of war exists between Persia, led by King Xerxes (Rodrigo Santoro), and Greece. At the Battle of Thermopylae, Leonidas (Gerard Butler), king of the Greek city state of Sparta, leads his badly outnumbered warriors against the massive Persian army. Though certain death awaits the Spartans, their sacrifice inspires all of Greece to unite against their common enemy.

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Xerxes, driven by vengeance for his father's death, leads an army against Greece; Greek city-states join forces under Athens' command to fight Artemisia in a naval battle.

programme.title: Piranha
programme.desc: Spring break turns gory when an underground tremor releases hundreds of prehistoric, carnivorous fish into Lake Victoria, a popular waterside resort. Local cop Julie Forester (Elisabeth Shue) must join forces with a band of unlikely strangers -- though they are badly outnumbered -- to destroy the ravenous creatures before everyone becomes fish food.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: When God decides that mankind has become too sinful and must be wiped off the Earth, he chooses Noah (Russell Crowe), a pious man, for a great task. Noah must build an ark large enough to hold his wife (Jennifer Connelly), adopted daughter (Emma Watson), sons (Logan Lerman, Douglas Booth, Leo McHugh Carroll) and their wives -- plus breeding pairs of every animal. When the task is completed, Noah and his family witness God's wrath in the form of an apocalyptic flood.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Brad Whitaker (Will Ferrell) is a kindhearted radio executive who wants to be the best possible stepfather to his wife's (Linda Cardellini) two children. When her freewheeling ex-husband, Dusty (Mark Wahlberg), breezes back into town, Brad's feeling of insecurity quickly develops into an inferiority complex. As Dusty demonstrates his flair for athletics, home repair and bad-boy charisma, Whitaker finds himself in a no-holds-barred battle to one-up his rival and win the approval of his family.

programme.title: The Bodyguard
programme.desc: Best-selling pop diva Rachel Marron has a stalker whose obsession has risen to the level of disturbing threats. At the urging of her manager, Rachel hires former Secret Service agent Frank Farmer as her bodyguard. Initially resented and treated with disdain for his hard-nosed security procedures, Farmer soon becomes an integral part of Rachel's inner circle. As they spend more time together, client and protector become closer still.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated.

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: On Nov. 4, 1979, militants storm the U.S. embassy in Tehran, Iran, taking 66 American hostages. Amid the chaos, six Americans manage to slip away and find refuge with the Canadian ambassador. Knowing that it's just a matter of time before the refugees are found and likely executed, the U.S. government calls on extractor Tony Mendez (Ben Affleck) to rescue them. Mendez's plan is to pose as a Hollywood producer scouting locations in Iran and train the refugees to act as his "film" crew.

programme.title: The Intern
programme.desc: Starting a new job can be a difficult challenge, especially if you're already retired. Looking to get back into the game, 70-year-old widower Ben Whittaker seizes the opportunity to become a senior intern at an online fashion site. Ben soon becomes popular with his younger co-workers, including Jules Ostin, the boss and founder of the company. Whittaker's charm, wisdom and sense of humor help him develop a special bond and growing friendship with Jules.

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished; trying to help some teens, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now, David's in big debt to his supplier and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang.

programme.title: The November Man
programme.desc: Five years into his retirement, CIA veteran Peter Devereaux (Pierce Brosnan) is pulled back into service to help retrieve a Russian agent -- also his former lover -- who has incriminating evidence on Federov, a corrupt Russian leader. When a different CIA team, led by Devereaux's former protege (Luke Bracey), shows up, the mission goes south and Devereaux's ex-lover is killed. Now a rogue agent, Devereaux drags a relief worker (Olga Kurylenko) along on his mission to settle the score.

programme.title: Machete Kills
programme.desc: When the president (Carlos Estevez) of the United States has a mission that would be impossible for just any mortal man, the person he needs is Machete (Danny Trejo), a knife-wielding ex-Federale agent. Machete's mission is to take down Voz (Mel Gibson), a madman revolutionary and an eccentric billionaire arms dealer who has come up with a plot to start a nuclear war. Facing death at every turn from assassins, Machete pulls out all of his skills to get the job done.

programme.title: Colossal
programme.desc: Gloria is an out-of-work party girl who leaves New York and moves back to her hometown after getting kicked out of her apartment by her boyfriend. When news reports surface that a giant creature is destroying Seoul, South Korea, Gloria gradually comes to the realization that she is somehow connected to this far-off phenomenon. As events begin to spiral out of control, she must figure out why her seemingly insignificant existence is having such a colossal effect on the fate of the world.

programme.title: Love and Monsters
programme.desc: Seven years after the Monsterpocalypse, Joel Dawson, along with the rest of humanity, has been living underground ever since giant creatures took control of the land. After reconnecting over the radio with his high school girlfriend, Aimee, who is now 80 miles away at a coastal colony, Joel begins to fall for her again. As Joel realizes that there's nothing left for him underground, he decides to venture out to Aimee, despite all the dangerous monsters that stand in his way.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 3
programme.desc: A videographer becomes obsessed with finding the source of disturbing late-night noises in his home and discovers its terrifying origin.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity 4
programme.desc: It has been five years since Katie (Katie Featherston) murdered her sister and disappeared with her infant nephew, Hunter, in tow. Now, a new family is about to fall prey to nighttime terrors. A mysterious accident next door leads to teenage Alex (Kathryn Newton) and her family becoming the temporary guardians of Robbie (Brady Allen), a very creepy neighbor boy. Cameras installed throughout Alex's home capture the sinister events that unfold after Robbie's arrival.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Average Joe's Gym and its owner, Peter La Fleur (Vince Vaughn), are both down on their luck. A fancy competing gym called Globo-Gym, run by the maniacal health nut White Goodman (Ben Stiller), is about to put Average Joe's out of business unless Peter can raise $50,000 to keep his mortgage. To save the gym, Peter and a ragtag group of Average Joe's members and employees enter a dodgeball contest with a big cash prize. In response, White forms his own Globo-Gym team to rout the competition.

programme.title: Magic Mike
programme.desc: By day, Mike (Channing Tatum) makes ends meet any way he can -- handyman jobs, detailing cars or designing furniture. But nighttime is when Mike really gets to display his many talents: He's the hot headliner in an all-male revue. Mike sees potential in a 19-year-old he dubs the Kid (Alex Pettyfer), takes the teen under his wing and instructs him in the tricks of the trade. However, Mike learns there's a downside to the stripper lifestyle when it threatens his romance with the Kid's sister.

programme.title: I Was a Stranger
programme.desc: Tragedy strikes a Syrian family in Aleppo, starting a chain reaction of events involving five different families in four different countries.

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: On Nov. 4, 1979, militants storm the U.S. embassy in Tehran, Iran, taking 66 American hostages. Amid the chaos, six Americans manage to slip away and find refuge with the Canadian ambassador. Knowing that it's just a matter of time before the refugees are found and likely executed, the U.S. government calls on extractor Tony Mendez (Ben Affleck) to rescue them. Mendez's plan is to pose as a Hollywood producer scouting locations in Iran and train the refugees to act as his "film" crew.

programme.title: Homestead
programme.desc: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos.

programme.title: The Babysitter
programme.desc: Jennifer (Alicia Silverstone) is a lovely teen who has been hired to baby-sit the kids of Harry Tucker (J.T. Walsh) and his wife, Dolly (Lee Garlington). The Tuckers go to a party and proceed to get inebriated, with Mr. Tucker fantasizing about his beautiful baby sitter. Meanwhile, Jack (Jeremy London), her boyfriend, and Mark (Nicky Katt), another guy interested in her, decide to spy on Jennifer at the Tucker house, with each young man also fixated on her.

programme.title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
programme.desc: A hardworking and bright high-school senior, Leigh Ann (Katie Holmes) has her impending status as valedictorian jeopardized when her bitter history teacher, Mrs. Tingle (Helen Mirren), gives her a poor grade on a project. This antagonistic relationship quickly escalates until circumstances lead Leigh Ann and her friends Luke (Barry Watson) and Jo Lynn (Marisa Coughlan) to hold Tingle hostage in her home. As the conflict continues, it looks as if not everyone will make it out alive.

programme.title: The Score
programme.desc: Career thief Nick Wells (Robert De Niro) is about to mastermind a nearly impossible theft that will require his joining forces with a clever young accomplice (Edward Norton). The unlikely alliance, arranged by Nick's longtime friend and fence, Max (Marlon Brando), interrupts Nick's plan to retire from crime and settle down with his fiancée, Diane (Angela Bassett). Worse, it requires that Nick violate his most important rule: Always work alone.

programme.title: Sleeping Dogs
programme.desc: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past.

programme.title: The Uninvited
programme.desc: After spending time in a psychiatric facility, young Anna (Emily Browning) finds significant changes in store at home. Her widowed father (David Strathairn) is now engaged to her mother's former nurse, Rachel (Elizabeth Banks). One night, the ghost of Anna's mother appears, screaming for revenge and accusing Rachel of murder. Anna and her sister, Alex (Arielle Kebbel), start to investigate, but they may be unprepared for the lethal battle of wills that ensues.

programme.title: Twisted
programme.desc: Kara and Tyler are planning on getting married when Tyler's ex-girlfriend returns from rehab, determined to get her life back - starting with Tyler.

programme.title: The Cured
programme.desc: After years of a zombie plague that ravaged Europe, humanity grapples with how to reintegrate the former zombies into society.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Slow-witted Forrest Gump (Tom Hanks) has never thought of himself as disadvantaged, and thanks to his supportive mother (Sally Field), he leads anything but a restricted life. Whether dominating on the gridiron as a college football star, fighting in Vietnam or captaining a shrimp boat, Forrest inspires people with his childlike optimism. But one person Forrest cares about most may be the most difficult to save -- his childhood love, the sweet but troubled Jenny (Robin Wright).

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady Heron enrolls at North Shore High School near Chicago after living in Africa. She interacts with Regina George, a prominent student who previously dated Aaron Samuels. Conflict arises when Heron develops an interest in Samuels, leading George to feign a friendship with Heron while attempting to maintain her relationship with Samuels. Both students engage in competitive social behavior that affects the student body.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: When David Greene (Brendan Fraser) receives a football scholarship to a prestigious prep school in the 1950s, he feels pressure to hide the fact that he is Jewish from his classmates and teachers, fearing that they may be anti-Semitic. He quickly becomes the big man on campus thanks to his football skills, but when his Jewish background is discovered, his worst fears are realized and his friends (Matt Damon, Chris O'Donnell) turn on him with violent threats and public ridicule.

programme.title: Dean
programme.desc: An illustrator falls in love with a woman while trying to keep his father from burning down the family home after his wife dies.

programme.title: Nancy Drew
programme.desc: Amateur sleuth Nancy Drew (Emma Roberts) accompanies her father (Tate Donovan) on a business trip to Los Angeles and stumbles across evidence in the case of a movie star's long-unsolved death. The young heroine's resourcefulness and integrity are put to the test in the glamorous -- but sometimes treacherous -- world of Hollywood.

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Now that Dracula has opened the Hotel Transylvania's doors to humans, things are changing for the better; however, Drac is secretly worried that his half-human grandson, Dennis, isn't showing his vampire side. So, while Mavis and Johnny are away, Drac enlists his friends to help him put the boy through a "monster-in-training" boot camp. But things really get batty when Drac's cantankerous, old-school dad pays an unexpected visit.

programme.title: Sabrina
programme.desc: Sabrina Fairchild is a chauffeur's daughter who grew up with the wealthy Larrabee family. She always had unreciprocated feelings for David, the family's younger son and playboy. But after returning from Paris, Sabrina has become a glamorous woman who gets David's attention. His older, work-minded brother Linus thinks their courtship is bad for the family business and tries to break them up -- but then he starts to fall for her too.

programme.title: Three Wishes
programme.desc: When single mother Jeanne Holman turns to avoid hitting a dog with her station wagon, she unwittingly hits bearded drifter Jack McCloud. Against the protests of her scandalized neighbors, Holman insists that the injured man stay at the Holman residence to heal. As the eccentric McCloud recovers from the accident, he becomes a positive influence on -- and an unexpected father figure to -- her young sons, Tom and Gunny.

programme.title: Grumpy Old Men
programme.desc: John Gustafson (Jack Lemmon) and Max Goldman (Walter Matthau) are two curmudgeonly neighbors who have been at each other's throats for years. The rivalry of the former friends intensifies when Ariel (Ann-Margret) comes along and provides a love interest for both of them. When Max finds out that John is experiencing family troubles and financial ruin, however, he steps in to help. Their bond is further cemented when John has a health scare and Max makes the ultimate sacrifice for his friend.

programme.title: Magic Mike XXL
programme.desc: It's been three years since Mike Lane's (Channing Tatum) retirement from stripping, but the former dancer misses the excitement and feeling of being on stage. Most of all, though, he misses the best friends that he ever had, the crew known as the Kings of Tampa. Opportunity comes knocking when the guys look him up as they travel to Myrtle Beach, S.C., for a stripper convention. With the promise of outrageous fun, a reinvigorated Mike can't resist the chance to join in and take it off again.

programme.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
programme.desc: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud.

programme.title: Life During Wartime
programme.desc: Nothing comes easily for Joy (Shirley Henderson) and her sisters, Trish (Allison Janney) and Helen (Ally Sheedy). Joy, unhappy with her job and her sleazy husband (Michael Kenneth Williams), is haunted by her dead boyfriend's ghost (Paul Reubens). Trish's pedophile husband (Ciarán Hinds) is behind bars, and she's ready to move on with her life. As an increasingly bitter Helen approaches middle age with a failing screenwriting career, it becomes clear her mother offers little comfort.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: It sounds like just another urban legend -- a videotape filled with nightmarish images leads to a phone call foretelling the viewer's death in exactly seven days. Newspaper reporter Rachel Keller (Naomi Watts) is skeptical of the story until four teenagers all die mysteriously exactly one week after watching just such a tape. Allowing her investigative curiosity to get the better of her, Rachel tracks down the video and watches it. Now she has just seven days to unravel the mystery.

programme.title: The Ring Two
programme.desc: A female journalist (Naomi Watts) must prevent evil Samara from taking possession of her son's (David Dorfman) soul.

programme.title: Just Another Immigrant: Romesh at the Greek
programme.desc: Romesh Ranganathan, a successful comedian in England, moves his entire family to Los Angeles to make it as a comedian in America; he then takes the drastic step of performing his first ever U.S. stand-up show at the historic Greek Theatre.

programme.title: Pretty Red Dress
programme.desc: The story of Travis, Candice and their daughter, Kenisha, and their relationships with the same red dress.

programme.title: King Kong
programme.desc: When a research ship is sent to explore an island thought to be rich in oil, paleontologist Jack Prescott sneaks aboard, having heard strange rumors about the island. En route, the crew rescues Dwan, the sole survivor of a shipwreck. When they arrive, they find native people living in fear of a monster called Kong. The natives kidnap Dwan and sacrifice her to what turns out to be an enormous ape. Dwan is eventually rescued, and the ape captured for a gala exhibit.

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire.

programme.title: Terminator: Dark Fate
programme.desc: In Mexico City, a newly modified liquid Terminator -- the Rev-9 model -- arrives from the future to kill a young factory worker named Dani Ramos. Also sent back in time is Grace, a hybrid cyborg human who must protect Ramos from the seemingly indestructible robotic assassin. But the two women soon find some much-needed help from a pair of unexpected allies -- seasoned warrior Sarah Connor and the T-800 Terminator.

programme.title: Apocalypse Now Redux
programme.desc: Secret ops assassin Captain Willard (Martin Sheen) is sent on a mission up a river during the Vietnam War to "terminate with extreme prejudice" the errant Colonel Kurtz (Marlon Brando). In addition to being re-edited with the new footage, the film has been completely restored, converted to digital, and reprinted by dye-transfer, improving color reproduction.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: On the eve of D-Day, American paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to penetrate the walls of a fortified church and destroy a radio transmitter. As the soldiers approach their target, they soon begin to realize that there's more going on in the Nazi-occupied village than a simple military operation. Making their way to an underground lab, the outnumbered men stumble upon a sinister experiment that forces them into a vicious battle against an army of the undead.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Ryan Fleege, wife Emily, and their 7-year-old daughter, Leila, prepare for Christmas in their new home. After finding an old and mysterious camcorder, Ryan quickly learns that it can record strange apparitions that are invisible to the naked eye. When young Leila starts talking to an imaginary friend and displaying strange behavior, the couple soon find themselves in a terrifying battle with a supernatural force.

programme.title: Marathon Man
programme.desc: Thomas "Babe" Levy (Dustin Hoffman) is a Columbia graduate student and long-distance runner who is oblivious to the fact that his older brother, Doc (Roy Scheider), is a government agent chasing down a Nazi war criminal (Laurence Olivier) -- that is, until Doc is murdered and Babe finds himself knee-deep in a tangle of stolen gems and sadistic madmen. Even his girlfriend, Elsa (Marthe Keller), becomes a suspect as everything Babe believed to be true is suddenly turned upside down.

programme.title: The Return
programme.desc: After 20 years away, Odysseus washes up on the shores of Ithaca, haggard and unrecognizable. The king finds much has changed since he left to fight in the Trojan War. His beloved wife, Penelope, is a prisoner in her own home and hounded to choose a new husband. Their son faces death at the hands of suitors who see him as an obstacle in their pursuit of Penelope and the kingdom. Odysseus is no longer the mighty warrior his people remember, but he must face his past to save his family.

programme.title: Tale of the Mummy
programme.desc: Fifty years ago, Sir Richard Turkel (Christopher Lee) met disaster while exploring the supposedly cursed tomb of the ancient Egyptian tyrant Talos. Now his granddaughter, archaeologist Samantha Turkel (Louise Lombard), eagerly picks up where he left off, delving into its depths to uncover Talos' sarcophagus. But, shortly after the tomb's artifacts are transferred to a London museum, a strange series of murders begins to plague the city. Baffled local detectives enlist Samantha for help.

programme.title: Sweetness
programme.desc: When a superfan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him. What started as compassion soon turns into captivity as she locks him away in the name of love.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: Brad Pitt stars as Jerry Welbach, a reluctant bagman, who has been given two ultimatums: The first is from his mob boss to travel to Mexico and retrieve a priceless antique pistol, known as "the Mexican"... or suffer the consequences. The second is from his girlfriend Samantha (Julia Roberts) to end his association with the mob. Jerry figures alive and in trouble with Samantha is better than the more permanent alternative, so he heads south of the border.

programme.title: My Cousin Vinny
programme.desc: New York lawyer Vinny has never won a case. When his teenage cousin Bill and his friend Stan are accused of murder in a backwater Alabama town, it's up to the nervous Vinny to save him from jail, even though he's only ever tried personal injury cases before, and none of them successfully.

programme.title: Frida
programme.desc: This is the true story of Frida Kahlo (Salma Hayek) and her husband Diego Rivera (Alfred Molina), the larger-than-life painters who became the most acclaimed artists in Mexican history, and whose tempestuous love affair, landmark journeys to America, and outrageous personalities made them legendary.

programme.title: Ask the Dust
programme.desc: Arturo Bandini is a writer who moves from Colorado to Los Angeles with aspirations of completing a great novel. There he meets bold Mexican waitress Camilla. She wants to live a better life and thinks marrying for money may be her answer. Arturo, who tries to project a confidence that he is inwardly lacking, initially acts coldly toward Camilla. Despite not seeming like a viable match, a romance gradually develops between the two.

programme.title: Urban Cowboy
programme.desc: After moving to Pasadena, Texas, country boy Bud Davis starts hanging around a bar called Gilley's, where he falls in love with Sissy, a cowgirl who believes the sexes are equal. They eventually marry, but their relationship is turbulent due to Bud's traditional view of gender roles. Jealousy over his rival, Wes, leads to their separation, but Bud attempts to win Sissy back by triumphing at Gilley's mechanical bull-riding competition.

programme.title: She's the Man
programme.desc: Romantic complications ensue when a student poses as her twin brother and replaces him at his boarding school.

programme.title: An Unfinished Life
programme.desc: Einar (Robert Redford), a recovering alcoholic rancher who lives with his loyal pal Mitch (Morgan Freeman), gets an unexpected visit from his daughter-in-law, Jean (Jennifer Lopez), and granddaughter, Griff (Becca Gardner). Einar holds a grudge against Jean because he feels she's responsible for his son's accidental death, but he reluctantly lets her stay at the farm when he learns that she's trapped in a violent relationship. Over time, they grow closer and try to heal their emotional wounds.

programme.title: The Time Traveler's Wife
programme.desc: Chicago librarian Henry De Tamble (Eric Bana) suffers from a rare genetic disorder that causes him to drift uncontrollably back and forth through time. On one of his sojourns, he meets the love of his life, Clare (Rachel McAdams), and they marry. But the problems and complexities of any relationship are multiplied by Henry's inability to remain in one time and place, so that he and his beloved are continually out of sync.

programme.title: We're the Millers
programme.desc: Small-time pot dealer David learns the hard way that no good deed goes unpunished; trying to help some teens, he is jumped by thugs and loses his cash and stash. Now, David's in big debt to his supplier and to wipe the slate clean, he must go to Mexico to pick up the guy's latest shipment. To accomplish his mission, Dave devises a foolproof plan: He packs a fake family into a huge RV and heads south of the border for a wild weekend that is sure to end with a bang.

programme.title: A Haunted House
programme.desc: Young couple Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) and Kisha (Essence Atkins) have just moved into their dream home. As they settle in, they learn that they're not alone -- not because the house is haunted, but because Kisha is possessed by a demon. Desperate to salvage his relationship -- and more importantly -- his sex life -- Malcolm hires a coterie of paranormal specialists, which includes a priest and ghost busters, to banish the unwelcome intruder from Kisha's body.

programme.title: A Haunted House 2
programme.desc: After the ordeal he suffered with his now former girlfriend's (Essence Atkins) demonic possession, Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) has decided to start fresh. He has a new girlfriend named Megan (Jaime Pressly), and they and Megan's children are moving into their dream home. Soon afterward, Malcolm is once again plagued by supernatural shenanigans -- only this time, it's not just the house that's haunted. A demon has attached itself to Malcolm, and shows no signs of letting go.

programme.title: Nightbitch
programme.desc: Une femme fait une pause dans sa carrière pour devenir mère au foyer, mais sa nouvelle vie prend rapidement un virage surréaliste.

Malgré le cadre idyllique, la beauté des gens, le champagne qui coule à flots et les soirées dansantes, Frida sent que cette île a quelque chose de plus terrifiant qu'elle n'y paraît.

Lorsqu'un voyage à la plage laisse son ami Robot rouillé et immobilisé dans le sable, Dog doit malheureusement retourner seul à sa vie d'avant.

programme.title: Witness for the Prosecution
programme.desc: The affable Leonard Vole (Tyrone Power) is being tried for the murder of a wealthy woman, and legendary lawyer Sir Wilfrid Robarts (Charles Laughton) has chosen to represent him. Unfortunately, Leonard's alibi depends on the testimony of his callous wife, Christine (Marlene Dietrich) -- who, after the discovery of a legal loophole, makes the shocking decision to appear in court against him. To Sir Wilfrid's surprise, this is only the first in a series of puzzling revelations and reversals.

programme.title: Stage Fright
programme.desc: The police think actor Jonathan Cooper (Richard Todd) is a murderer, and now they're on his tail. He asserts that it was his lover, the famous actress Charlotte Inwood (Marlene Dietrich), who killed the victim (not coincidentally, her husband). He seeks shelter with his ex-girlfriend Eve (Jane Wyman), a budding actress. Convinced Jonathan is innocent, Eve plays detective and assumes multiple disguises. But once she is entangled in a web of deception, she fears everyone in fact wears a mask.

programme.title: The Unknown
programme.desc: On the run from the law, Alonzo (Lon Chaney) hides in the circus as The Armless Wonder -- a performer who uses his feet to hurl knives. Alonzo actually has the use of his arms but keeps them concealed so that his true identity remains under wraps. Meanwhile, Alonzo falls in love with another performer, Nanon (Joan Crawford), who has a phobia against being touched by a man. But when the circus owner (Nick De Ruiz) discovers Alonzo's true identity, the performer makes a tragic decision.

programme.title: Day of Wrath
programme.desc: In a Danish village in the early 1600s, a young woman named Anne, whose mother was thought to be a witch, develops sympathy toward an old woman, Marte, who is accused of witchcraft. The intervention of Anne's older but kindly husband, Pastor Absalon saved her mother -- but now, urged on by his overbearing mother, he refuses to help Marte. When Absalon's son returns home and is attracted to Anne, it's a matter of time before her family destiny catches up with her.

programme.title: Ordet
programme.desc: The three sons of devout Danish farmer Morten (Henrik Malberg) have widely disparate religious beliefs. Youngest son Anders (Cay Kristiansen) shares his father's religion, but eldest son Mikkel (Emil Hass Christensen) has lost his faith, while middle child Johannes (Preben Lerdorff Rye) has become delusional and proclaims that he is Jesus Christ himself. When Mikkel's wife, Inger (Birgitte Federspiel) goes into a difficult childbirth, everyone's beliefs are put to the test.

programme.title: Gold Rush Maisie
programme.desc: Driving along on her way to a gig at the Hula Parlor Café, Maisie Ravier (Ann Sothern) is stalled when she has engine troubles. She is forced to hitchhike into town, only to discover that the job's already been taken. On the upside, Maisie hears about a gold rush just outside the area and decides to go into business with the Davises, a family of poor prospectors, as well as Bill Anders (Lee Bowman), a crotchety ranch owner who may be unknowingly sitting on a valuable vein of gold.

programme.title: Maisie Gets Her Man
programme.desc: Chicago showgirl Maisie Ravier (Ann Sothern) falls on hard times and begins a job working for Pappy (Allen Jenkins), a decent building manager. When she ends up getting them both fired, she lands a new position as an assistant to an aspiring comedian, Hap (Red Skelton). Hap's failings on stage, however, leave them in need of another job: working for a con man (Lloyd Corrigan) who bottles tap water. Eventually, Maisie and Hap fall for each other, but he still has a fiancée back home.

programme.title: The Barbarian
programme.desc: An Egyptian-American woman (Myrna Loy) runs around Cairo with a desert charmer (Ramon Novarro) who turns out to be a prince.

programme.title: When Ladies Meet
programme.desc: Reporter Jimmie Lee (Robert Montgomery) suspects his long-time girlfriend, successful novelist Mary Howard (Myrna Loy), of having a romance with her married publisher, Rogers Woodruff (Frank Morgan). While Mary works on her latest novel -- about a married woman allowing her husband to desert her for his mistress -- Jimmie meets Woodruff's wife, Clare (Ann Harding). Realizing she is unaware of her husband's affair, he convinces Clare to meet Mary while pretending to be his new girlfriend.

programme.title: Penthouse
programme.desc: After lawyer Jackson Durant (Warner Baxter) successfully defends racketeer Tony Gazotti (Nat Pendleton), Durant's fiancée, Sue (Martha Sleeper), leaves him. However, she soon needs his help when her new beau, Tom (Phillips Holmes), is accused of killing his old girlfriend (Mae Clarke). Durant takes the case, and, with the help of Gazotti and Gertie (Myrna Loy), the victim's roommate, he determines that crime boss Jim Crelliman (C. Henry Gordon) played a role in the murder.

programme.title: The Next Generation
programme.desc:
Star Trek: La nueva generación o Viaje a las estrellas: La nueva generación en Uruguay (Star Trek: The Next Generation) (algunas veces abreviada ST:TNG o TNG) es una serie de ciencia ficción estadounidense dentro del universo de Star Trek. Situada en el siglo XXIV, 21 años después de Star Trek: la serie original, el programa cuenta con una nueva tripulación y una nueva nave Enterprise. Su estreno fue el 28 de septiembre de 1987, contando con más de 27 millones de televidentes el episodio piloto "Encuentro en Farpoint". Con un total de 178 episodios (el mayor número de episodios que haya tenido alguna serie de Star Trek) y siete temporadas, llegó a su fin el 23 de mayo de 1994, con el episodio "Todas las cosas buenas".
Los episodios siguen las aventuras de la tripulación del USS Enterprise (NCC-1701-D), una nave clase Galaxia. Como nave insignia de la Federación Unida de Planetas, la Enterprise está diseñada para la exploración y la diplomacia, pero preparada para la batalla si fuera necesario. Su capitán es el conocido y carismático Jean-Luc Picard, mucho más intelectual y filosófico que el típico protagonista de una serie de ciencia ficción. ★ 8.4/10

programme.title: Learn
programme.desc:
Su difunto padre siempre dijo que un hombre inútil debería esforzarse por ser útil, por lo que para ese fin, y para dar una vida mejor a su familia de bajos recursos, su objetivo es obtener la recomendación especial VIP, una prestigiosa beca que cubre todas las futuras matrículas universitarias. Aunque Nariyuki podría ser el candidato para la nominación, sus compañeras de clase Rizu Ogata y Fumino Furuhashi lo eclipsan constantemente en matemáticas y literatura, respectivamente.
Para su deleite, Nariyuki recibe la nominación, pero hay un problema: ¡tiene que dar clases particulares a sus dos compañeras de clase, que son cada una mediocres sin remedio en el tema de especialización de la otra! Para empeorar las cosas, dichos temas son los que quieren estudiar para su futuro. A medida que se acerca el momento de presentar las solicitudes universitarias, Nariyuki debe encontrar un método de tutoría efectivo para las niñas antes de que sea demasiado tarde. ★ 8.4/10

programme.title: Los fogones tradicionales
programme.desc: En nuestro viaje con los fogones tradicionales vamos a regresar a tres pueblos pertenecientes a las provincias de Cuenca y de Huesca. En Villar de la Encina, nos van a recibir con unas patatas escurrizas típicas de La Manchuela Conquense. De allí nos desplazaremos hasta Vega del Codorno, donde nos esperan con unas sabrosas judías con perdiz. Y terminaremos nuestro recorrido en el pueblo altoaragonés de Conchel, donde degustaremos un exquisito guiso de perdiz.

programme.title: Las recetas rápidas de Nadiya
programme.desc: Nadiya prepara: Macarrones con queso definitivos, Vindaloo de ternera picante, Tostada francesa de pan brioche y Tarta de helado con arándanos. Hoy la escritora Olia Hercules prepara un borscht.

programme.title: Tapeo español
programme.desc: Viajamos al Oviedo más gastronómico para conocer su tradición. En calle Gascona probamos chorizo a la sidrería Tierra Astur y hacemos una parada en El Ferroviario. Vivimos el ritual del vermú y gambas en La Paloma, disfrutamos de aperitivos en Jamón Jamón y cerramos con tortos de maíz en Alterna y bollines preñaos en Casa González Suárez.

programme.title: Nuestros arroces
programme.desc: Quique Barella viaja hasta Chiva para descubrir una paella de marisco con carpaccio de gamba y elabora un arroz de gamba y lubina en lata.

programme.desc: Empezamos en el viejo caserío de Astarbe, cerca de Donosti. Paramos en Monesterio (Badajoz), templo del jamón. Y en la bodega de San Rafael de Camas no nos resistimos a su despensa.

programme.title: Los grandes de España
programme.desc: El salmorejo es uno de los grandes iconos de la cocina cordobesa. Guiados por Matías Vega, descubrimos su elaboración tradicional, sus ingredientes esenciales y la historia que encierra esta receta.

programme.title: Dulces con Alma
programme.desc: Alma da una clase magistral de cómo preparar unos cupcakes de 'speculoos' y unos profiteroles de pistacho que harán las delicias de familia e invitados.

programme.title: Me voy a comer el mundo
programme.desc: Verónica descubre Asunción junto a Natalia Dávalos y conoce a Benjamín Benítez. El viaje sigue a Ciudad del Este, continúa en una comunidad indígena guaraní y finaliza con el toque dulce de Verónica.

programme.title: Busco piso
programme.desc: Acompañamos a los futuros compradores en la elección de su nueva casa, viendo, en cada episodio, tres pisos diferentes con sus distintas posibilidades.

programme.title: Limpia y ordena
programme.desc: Un equipo de tres expertos compuesto por una auténtica maestra de la limpieza, un carpintero y un constructor, ayudan a los propietarios de casas sucias y desordenadas a recuperar su espacio y volver a enamorarse de su hogar.

programme.title: Mi casa cámper
programme.desc: ¿Se puede trabajar desde una playa virgen? ¿Abrir la ventana cada día y encontrarte con un paisaje diferente? ¿Es posible meter todo lo que necesitas para vivir en un vehículo? Prepárate porque la respuesta a estas preguntas las encontrarás en Mi casa cámper. Te invitamos a conocer el fascinante mundo de la camperización de furgonetas y otros vehículos convertidos en pequeñas casas con todo tipo de lujos, como baños futuristas, cocinas completamente equipadas, salón con proyector y pantalla de cine, o un rincón con chimenea. La creatividad no tiene límites en estos espacios donde algunos de sus propietarios no solo viajan y experimentan todo tipo de aventuras, sino que también viven de forma permanente. Además, de la mano de talleres especializados descubrirás las últimas novedades en cuanto a materiales, distribución del vehículo y equipamiento. Abróchate el cinturón para vivir esta nueva aventura. ¡Arrancamos Mi casa cámper.

programme.title: De ruina a palacio
programme.desc: En Cadaqués, Àngels Sabater transformó una masía en una espectacular vivienda. Álvaro Cordero Iturregui, en el País Vasco, hizo de un caserío una moderna casa que respeta su esencia rústica.

programme.title: Tus plantas decoran
programme.desc: Van Gogh decía: ''Si realmente amas la naturaleza, encontrarás la belleza en todas partes''. Una afirmación que comprobaremos muy de cerca al descubrir el Real Jardín Botánico CSIC, un auténtico museo vivo que alberga más de 5.500 especies de plantas de todo el mundo. Fuera de esta visita, Natalia nos demostrará cómo la naturaleza puede ser arte a través de plantas, ideas y plantitrucos sorprendentes con los que llenar nuestro hogar de vida.

programme.title: Mercedes Benz Fashion Week
programme.desc: Palomo Spain marca uno de los grandes hitos de la edición Primavera/Verano 2027 de Mercedes-Benz Fashion Week Madrid al celebrar su décimo aniversario en la Rosaleda del Parque del Oeste. A esta cita se suma el 20.º aniversario de la plataforma EGO, que conmemoraremos junto a Andrés Aberasturi, CEO de Pelonio Group y creador de la iniciativa. Además, descubriremos las nuevas propuestas de Odette Álvarez, Yolancris, Lola Casademunt by Maite y Custo Barcelona, firmas consolidadas con identidades muy distintas que vuelven a convertir la pasarela en un escaparate de creatividad y personalidad. El recorrido se completará con la propuesta de Alex Menorca, firma que nos acercará al talento de Canarias Islas de Moda.

programme.title: Castillos y palacios de Europa
programme.desc: Cruzamos los Cárpatos hacia el inquietante Castillo de Bran, hogar del mito de Drácula, para luego buscar refugio en el palacio checo de Jindřichův Hradec. Entre pasadizos ocultos y los susurros de la Dama Blanca, descubrimos que los muros más bellos de Europa también albergan los secretos más oscuros.

programme.title: La casa más top

La fiesta vecinal de este año presenta tres casas suburbanas rediseñadas con maestría para satisfacer la pasión de anfitriones experimentados por organizar grandes fiestas. Los jueces están ansiosos por ser invitados y experimentar diferentes estilos de diseño, dinámicas de recepción y temas de conversación interesantes. Hay mucho en juego para estos anfitriones, y las malas críticas les afectarán profundamente.

programme.title: Sin identidad
programme.desc: El doctor Martin Harris está visitando Berlín con su esposa. Un accidente de tráfico trunca sus planes, provocándole un prolongado estado de coma. Cuando por fin despierta, descubre alarmado que alguien ha usurpado su identidad. El director catalán afincado en Hollywood, Jaume Collet-Serra, da en el clavo con este tenso thriller que logró situarse como número uno de la taquilla estadounidense en el momento de su estreno. El realizador de ''La casa de cera'' y ''La huérfana'' se convirtió así en el primer cineasta español en conseguir dicho éxito. Las claves del triunfo fueron varias: un ritmo ágil a base de secuencias con gancho, un reparto encabezado por Liam Neeson (''La lista de Schindler'') y Diane Kruger (''La búsqueda'') y la intervención del productor Joel Silver (''Matrix''), cuya colaboración con el director ya había dado sus frutos en el pasado. Rodada en Alemania y basada en la novela ''Out of My Head'', del francés Didier Van Cauwelaert, ''Sin identidad'' no se salvó de algunos reproches de la crítica, que coincidió en que el guion está lleno de disparates y momentos absurdos. Pese a ello, el filme es tan ágil y entretenido que consiguió el ansiado aprobado.

programme.title: Código de defensa
programme.desc: Tras muchos años de trabajo de campo, Emerson Kent, agente de operaciones encubiertas de la CIA, está ''quemado'' y sus jefes deciden enviarlo a Inglaterra a una tranquila y rutinaria misión. Tiene que proteger a Katherine, una operadora que se dedica a transmitir códigos para agentes y espías desde una base secreta subterránea en la campiña inglesa. Sin embargo, todo se complica cuando al llegar a la base, les tienden una emboscada. Ahora, Emerson tiene que mantener a Katherine y los códigos a salvo, cueste lo que cueste.

programme.title: Obituary
programme.desc: Elvira está segura que Mallory la traicionó hace cinco años, mientras que Mallory descubre que Elvira utilizó su teléfono para atraer al ya fallecido Sylvester Jennings.

programme.title: Obituary
programme.desc: Con el subconsciente de Elvira comenzando a llenar los espacios en blanco y el descubrimiento por parte de Ward de la carta de Hughie, padre e hija comienzan a armar el rompecabezas de la noche del asesinato de María.

programme.title: Arma letal
programme.desc: Cole ve la necesidad de hablar con Natalie sobre su relación. Murtaugh establece amistad con un inesperado nuevo aliado.

programme.title: Morgan
programme.desc: Una compañía tecnológica crea una inteligencia artificial, sin ser conscientes de su verdadero potencial. Cuando las cosas empiezan a escaparse de su control, deciden contratar a una especialista para determinar si acabar con la criatura o mantenerla encendida. Terrorífico thriller de ciencia ficción que significa el debut como director de cine de Luke Scott. Una propuesta cuyo argumento bebe de películas como ''Frankenstein'' o la saga ''Alien''. De hecho, el propio Scott participó en 2017 como realizador de dos cortometrajes que sirvieron como promoción de la cinta ''Alien: Covenant''. Al frente del reparto está Kate Mara, quien ya había trabajado con la productora Scott Free en ''Marte''. Del resto del reparto, destaca la presencia de Rose Leslie (conocida por el gran público gracias a su papel de Ygritte en ''Juego de tronos'') y de una inquietante Anya Taylor-Joy (''Múltiple''), quien encarna a la inteligencia artificial.

programme.title: Emily la estafadora
programme.desc: Emily (Aubrey Plaza), una joven con talento artístico y sueños frustrados, vive atrapada por una deuda universitaria de 70.000 dólares y un pasado de antecedentes penales que le cierra las puertas a trabajos estables. Desesperada por conseguir dinero, acepta una oferta aparentemente sencilla: ganar 200 dólares en una hora como compradora ficticia. Lo que empieza como un trabajo rápido se convierte en su entrada a un mundo clandestino de fraudes con tarjetas de crédito, compras ilegales y riesgos cada vez mayores. Guiada por Youcef (Theo Rossi), un carismático intermediario con ambiciones propias, Emily descubre que la línea entre la supervivencia y el crimen se desdibuja rápidamente, y un mundo donde las reglas favorecen a los poderosos y castigan a los vulnerables. ¿Hasta dónde está dispuesta a llegar para ser libre.

programme.title: Snake eyes (Ojos de serpiente)
programme.desc: Ricky Santoro es un policía corrupto de Atlantic City mucho más preocupado por conseguir los contactos necesarios para un ascenso que por realizar bien su trabajo. Sin embargo las cosas cambian al verse envuelto en el asesinato, durante un combate de boxeo, de un importante cargo político. Encargado del caso, pronto averiguará que se trata de una oscura conspiración. Después del éxito conseguido con ''Misión imposible'', Brian de Palma volvió a ponerse al servicio de una gran estrella, en este caso Nicolas Cage. Partiendo de un guión original de David Koepp, De Palma dirigió esta trama conspirativa donde abunda la corrupción y la ambigüedad moral. Pese a su intención de convertirse en un homenaje a cierto tipo de cine negro, ''Snake eyes (Ojos de serpiente)'' fue bastante mal recibida por la crítica, aunque en su paso por taquilla obtuvo un relativo éxito. A grandes rasgos, la película no fue considerada como uno de los mejores trabajos ni de De Palma ni de Cage, sobre todo por los continuos guiños y citas que el director utilizó a lo largo del metraje. Sin embargo, muchos críticos valoraron la fuerza de alguna secuencia y el trabajo de los secundarios.

programme.title: 60 segundos
programme.desc: Randall Memphis Raines es un exladrón de coches que hace ya algún tiempo que ha dejado atrás esta vida criminal. Pero su hermano pequeño, Kip, se ve envuelto en negocios sucios al querer imitarlo y Memphis se verá obligado a volver a robar para salvarlo. Dos actores con experiencia en el cine de acción, como Nicolas Cage (''Con Air'') y Angelina Jolie (''Lara Croft: Tomb Raider''), son las caras principales de ''60 segundos'', esta nueva versión de la película de 1974 ''Gone in 60 seconds'', de la que toma su idea principal: se puede robar un coche en tan solo un minuto. Está producida por el prolífico Jerry Bruckheimer, todo un especialista del género quien, curiosamente, fue quien descubrió el talento como héroe en películas adrenalínicas de Nicolas Cage, cuando le confió un papel importante en ''La Roca'' en 1996. En esta ocasión, el magnate del entretenimiento volvió a acertar con el reparto y el tándem protagonista se mostró imparable en taquilla, pues la cinta recaudó algo más de 77 millones de euros sólo en los Estados Unidos. Tanto fue su impacto, que en 2012 se arrestó a un grupo criminal llamado La pandilla de los 60 segundos por robar 39 coches en el Reino Unido.

programme.title: Deja Vu (Cambiando el pasado)
programme.desc: Doug Carlin es un agente con una increíble capacidad de análisis. Tras un atentado en Nueva Orleans, le recluta un equipo de investigación con una máquina que puede ver qué sucedió en el pasado. Trepidante thriller de ciencia ficción dirigido por el cineasta Tony Scott (''Top Gun'') y protagonizado por uno de sus actores fetiche, Denzel Washington. El neoyorquino ha sido dirigido en varias ocasiones por Scott, en títulos como ''El fuego de la venganza'', ''Imparable'' y ''Asalto al tren Pelham 123''. Completan el elenco actores conocidos para el gran público como Val Kilmer (''Heat''), Jim Caviezel (''Person of Interest'', ''La pasión de Cristo''), Paula Patton (''Misión imposible: Protocolo Fantasma'') y Bruce Greenwood (''Star Trek''). El prolífico productor Jerry Bruckheimer (''CSI'') consiguió con esta cinta un destacable éxito en taquilla, recaudando más de 130 millones de euros en todo el mundo. Cabe destacar a nivel de producción que la cinta se rodó en Nueva Orleans después de la brutal irrupción del huracán Katrina que asoló la mayor parte de la costa este de los Estados Unidos en 2005, causando más de 1.800 muertos y casi 100.000 millones de euros en daños materiales.

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: En una Tierra destruida y casi desierta, Jack es uno de los últimos hombres que la habitan. Es un ingeniero de drones que participa en una operación para extraer los recursos vitales del planeta. Película de ciencia ficción distópica ambientada en un mundo postapocalíptico, basada en la novela gráfica inédita ''Oblivion'' (no había visto la luz antes del estreno de la cinta), del mismo director Joseph Kosinski. Para realizarla, el cineasta no quiso abusar del croma, como había hecho con ''Tron: Legacy''; por eso, para realizar el set de la torre de cristal, quiso utilizar vidrio real y monitores gigantes con vídeos ya grabados. En el plano actoral, destaca la presencia de un Tom Cruise ya acostumbrado a propuestas de ciencia ficción (ya había protagonizado ''La guerra de los mundos'' y ''Minority report'', entre otras). Su compañera femenina tenía que ser Jessica Chastain (''Zero Dark Thirty''), pero conflictos de agenda le obligaron a abandonar el proyecto y dar el relevo a la chica Bond Olga Kurylenko (''007: Quantum of Solace'').

programme.title: The Game
programme.desc: Un millonario obsesionado por el orden y el control de su rutinaria vida se dispone a celebrar su cumpleaños. Ese mismo día, su hermano le ofrece un regalo muy especial: un juego con el que podrá olvidar la monotonía en la que está inmerso.

programme.title: Sicario 2: Soldado
programme.desc: En una guerra sin reglas contra el narcotráfico, la línea entre el bien y el mal desaparece cuando el gobierno de los Estados Unidos intensifica su lucha ante la amenaza de terroristas cruzando la frontera. El agente federal Matt Gaver (Josh Brolin) recurre al implacable Alejandro (Benicio Del Toro), un hombre marcado por la tragedia, para desatar una ofensiva brutal contra los cárteles. Pero cuando una decisión extrema convierte a una niña inocente en un daño colateral, ambos deberán enfrentarse a las consecuencias de sus actos. Un thriller tenso y provocador que expone el alto precio de la justicia y los límites de la moral.

programme.title: Billy Madison

Otherwise, the business will be turned over to Brian's conniving associate, Eric.

programme.title: Los fogones tradicionales
programme.desc: En nuestro viaje con los fogones tradicionales vamos a regresar a tres pueblos pertenecientes a las provincias de Cuenca y de Huesca. En Villar de la Encina, nos van a recibir con unas patatas escurrizas típicas de La Manchuela Conquense. De allí nos desplazaremos hasta Vega del Codorno, donde nos esperan con unas sabrosas judías con perdiz. programme.title: Mi casa cámper
programme.desc: ¿Se puede trabajar desde una playa virgen? ¿Abrir la ventana cada día y encontrarte con un paisaje diferente? ¿Es posible meter todo lo que necesitas para vivir en un vehículo? Prepárate porque la respuesta a estas preguntas las encontrarás en Mi casa cámper. Te invitamos a conocer el fascinante mundo de la camperización de furgonetas y otros vehículos convertidos en pequeñas casas con todo tipo de lujos, como baños futuristas, cocinas completamente equipadas, salón con proyector y pantalla de cine, o un rincón con chimenea. La creatividad no tiene límites en estos espacios donde algunos de sus propietarios no solo viajan y experimentan todo tipo de aventuras, sino que también viven de forma permanente. Además, de la mano de talleres especializados descubrirás las últimas novedades en cuanto a materiales, distribución del vehículo y equipamiento. Abróchate el cinturón para vivir esta nueva aventura. ¡Arrancamos Mi casa cámper.

programme.title: Tus plantas decoran
programme.desc: Van Gogh decía: ''Si realmente amas la naturaleza, encontrarás la belleza en todas partes''. Una afirmación que comprobaremos muy de cerca al descubrir el Real Jardín Botánico CSIC, un auténtico museo vivo que alberga más de 5.500 especies de plantas de todo el mundo. Fuera de esta visita, Natalia nos demostrará cómo la naturaleza puede ser arte a través de plantas, ideas y plantitrucos sorprendentes con los que llenar nuestro hogar de vida.

La fiesta vecinal de este año presenta tres casas suburbanas rediseñadas con maestría para satisfacer la pasión de anfitriones experimentados por organizar grandes fiestas. Los jueces están ansiosos por ser invitados y experimentar diferentes estilos de diseño, dinámicas de recepción y temas de conversación interesantes. Hay mucho en juego para estos anfitriones, y las malas críticas les afectarán profundamente.

Nuestra historia se desarrolla en la codiciada calle histórica arbolada de St. Clair, donde la belleza de estas casas centenarias es inigualable. Aunque innegablemente hermosas… ¿podrán los jueces pasar por alto las grietas y peculiaridades de los últimos 100 años.

programme.title: Reforma sin obra
programme.desc: El actual despacho de Ricardo reclama urgentemente una reforma sin obra. Gracias a Carol Botín, Ricardo tendrá un nuevo espacio que invitará al trabajo y del que, además, no querrá salir.

programme.title: De sin a con
programme.desc: Mónica Garrido crea una cocina con una gran isla, despensa y zona de lavado y hace de la terraza un lugar más apetecible. Adriana Somoza ha de transformar una suite y despacho en espacios femeninos.

programme.title: Los Scott: Reforma bajo presión
programme.desc: Los Scott: Reforma bajo presión - Los Scott: Reforma bajo presión 11.

programme.title: Busco piso
programme.desc: Después de años de esfuerzo, constancia y mucho ahorro, Alberto está preparado para cumplir uno de sus mayores objetivos: comprar su primera vivienda. Tiene muy claro lo que busca: un piso con dos habitaciones, un cuarto de baño, una cocina amplia y con personalidad y una terraza donde disfrutar de su tiempo libre. Sin embargo, encontrar un hogar que reúna todas esas características será mucho más complicado de lo que imaginaba. Para afrontar este reto contará con la ayuda de Alicia Mesa, la arquitecta que lo acompañará durante toda la búsqueda. Juntos visitarán diferentes viviendas que pondrán a prueba sus ideas iniciales y le demostrarán que, en ocasiones, merece la pena salir de la zona de confort para descubrir nuevas posibilidades. Gracias a la experiencia y el criterio de Alicia, Alberto aprenderá a valorar opciones que nunca se había planteado. En este capítulo de Busco Piso, veremos cómo años de ilusión y sacrificio desembocan en una decisión tan inesperada como acertada, dando comienzo a una nueva etapa llena de ilusión.

programme.title: Limpia y ordena
programme.desc: Mark Wright y el equipo de Limpia y ordena ayudan a Lyndee, madre de acogida, a preparar su casa para una nueva etapa: recibir a madres jóvenes y futuras mamás. Tras años de uso, dos dormitorios libres y un baño compartido ya no ofrecen los espacios tranquilos y prácticos que sus invitadas necesitan. Maxine Dwyer limpia a fondo y devuelve el orden, mientras Mark y el carpintero Derek Nesbeth replantean las habitaciones con colores relajantes, muebles que ahorran espacio y almacenaje inteligente. Un cambiador hecho a medida, un escritorio abatible y una cuna moisés convierten la habitación principal en una acogedora zona de bebé.

programme.title: Hoteles increíbles. La vida más allá del vestíbulo
programme.desc: Rob Rinder y Monica Galetti viajan al Datai Langkawi, en Malasia. Escondido bajo el dosel de la selva tropical, este hotel está tan integrado en la naturaleza que los monos pueden colarse en tu habitación si no cierras bien la puerta. Durante su estancia, Rob y Monica colaboran en tareas como cuidar el estanque de lirios o conducir carritos de golf por curvas de vértigo, mientras aprenden sobre los desafíos medioambientales y los esfuerzos que se hacen para gestionar un hotel en pleno corazón de la naturaleza.

programme.title: Los más...
programme.desc: Más allá de los límites de la realidad (The Twilight Zone) es una versión de la serie homónima de los años 60. La idea de la serie surgió de la posibilidad de crear un Senado controlado por robots. La serie utiliza la ciencia ficción como metáfora para explicar todo tipo de situaciones comunes y hacer así una crítica a la sociedad. Los temas que se tratan son muy distintos: histeria colectiva, guerra nuclear, capitalismo, dictaduras... Todos ellos estaban prohibidos y el autor y guionista, Rod Serling, se valía de la ciencia ficción para poder tratarlos de una forma única, haciendo que los censores pasaran por alto esta serie de televisión. Cada capítulo cuenta una historia completamente distinta al resto. ★ 7.7/10
