programme.title: Hallucinant!
programme.desc: S01 E03 Vapoter ou fumer? On se demande si vapoter est moins dangereux que fumer la cigarette.

programme.title: À la poursuite de la santé
programme.desc: S01 E03 Des communautés autochtones Au Québec, les communautés autochtones représentent un peu plus de 1% de la population québécoise ; on s'intéresse à leur conception de la santé et on explore les différents facteurs qui influencent positivement et négativement leur santé.

programme.title: La clinique des mots
programme.desc: Les poumons Quand on a un problème avec les poumons, on prend rendez-vous avec un ou une pneumologue, mais comment lui décrire ses symptômes si l'on ne sait pas vraiment ce qu'est une pneumonie, de l'asthme ou de la toux.

programme.title: Petits curieux, grands écrans
programme.desc: Écrans et développement du langage Les écrans peuvent nuire au développement du langage et de la communication chez les tout-petits ; ils isolent l'enfant, le privant d'interactions essentielles avec ses parents, nécessaires au développement de ses habiletés langagières.

programme.title: Parlons job
programme.desc: S01 E05 Bruit et audition Moteur assourdissant, fracas métallique, chocs répétés : le bruit industriel représente un risque pour l'audition des travailleurs et travailleuses ; aujourd'hui, les décibels sont mesurés avec minutie par les scientifiques.

programme.title: De la scie au bistouri
programme.desc: S03 E05 ITSS L'univers tabou et complexe des infections transmises sexuellement et par le sang (ITSS).

programme.title: La vie continue
programme.desc: S01 E05 Cancer du pancréas Le cancer du pancréas est l'un des cancers les plus meurtriers ; au Canada, il est associé au plus faible taux de survie à cinq ans ; le pancréas est un organe digestif vital dont la proximité avec les autres organes rend l'opération délicate.

programme.title: Face à la détresse
programme.desc: Précarité et dépendances Notre caméra suit un travailleur social en tournée dans un campement d'itinérance et une organisatrice communautaire en visite dans un organisme d'aide alimentaire ; une troisième professionnelle aide les personnes à se libérer d'une dépendance.

programme.title: Substances
programme.desc: Le Xanax et autres benzodiazépines Le Xanax et les benzodiazépines, souvent prescrits pour réduire le stress, sont aussi détournés à des fins récréatives ; leur usage croissant chez les jeunes et leur potentiel addictif suscitent des inquiétudes ; Sara Buzzell explore cette réalité.

programme.title: Créatures microscopiques
programme.desc: S01 E01 Le corps humain Chloé s'intéresse aux êtres qui vivent sur le corps comme les petits acariens qui se cachent dans les pores de son visage ; elle observe aussi les cellules qui évoluent dans son sang et dans un échantillon de sperme.

programme.title: Journée de prof
programme.desc: Audréanne Loiselle Andréanne Loiselle, de l'Université Laval, est une experte des milieux humides, ces écosystèmes essentiels à la santé de la planète.

programme.title: Dis-moi pas!? La petite histoire des mots d'ici
programme.desc: Chevreuil Chevreuil, cerf de Virginie, cerf tout court : trois noms en usage pour ce petit cervidé nord-américain ; qui plus est, au cours de l'histoire, il en a eu d'autres ; mais fort d'un usage de plus de 400 ans, le mot chevreuil a du panache.

programme.title: Créateurs de demain
programme.desc: S01 E01 Réduire l'impact de nos vêtements S'habiller autrement pour réduire l'empreinte écologique.

programme.title: Trouvez l'erreur
programme.desc: S01 E01 La glande tyrolienne Une des glandes que l'on retrouve au niveau du cou s'appelle la glande thyroïde et non tyrolienne ; chez le médecin, utiliser le mauvais terme pourrait conduire au mauvais traitement.

programme.title: La préhistoire du Québec
programme.desc: S01 E05 Des poissons à pattes C'est au Québec qu'un groupe de poissons a développé une particularité absolument renversante : des nageoires osseuses qui allaient éventuellement évoluer vers les premières pattes ; on parle ici des ancêtres de tous les animaux vertébrés terrestres.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: Astronomie: les planètes Les planètes se forment dans la foulée de la formation de leur étoile. Dans notre système solaire, tout a commencé il y a 4,5 milliards d'années. Une diversité incroyable de protoplanètes s'est formée autour de notre Soleil.

programme.title: Le sommeil en questions
programme.desc: S01 E01 Le changement d'heure, pour ou contre? On se demande quels sont les impacts du changement d'heure sur la santé et quels seraient les avantages de rester toute l'année à l'heure normale ; Jean-Daniel Doucet questionne le professeur émérite Joseph De Koninck à ce sujet.

programme.title: Trouvez l'erreur
programme.desc: S01 E02 Confortable Dans la langue française, un objet peut être confortable, mais pas une personne ; on dira plutôt qu'elle est à l'aise ; dans un lobby d'hôtel, ce mauvais usage du mot peut entraîner un quiproquo ; malaise garanti.

programme.title: Je suis là: les proches aidants en santé mentale
programme.desc: S01 E05 Les limites du système Paul et Néron plongent dans les réalités de Nicole, Jean-Hugues, Denis et Sylvie : crises, P-38, hospitalisation et démarches incessantes pour aider un enfant malade. Des parents épuisés, un système rigide, et des histoires qui se répondent.

programme.title: Petits curieux, grands écrans
programme.desc: La technoférence parentale La technoférence parentale désigne les interruptions dans l'interaction parent-enfant causées par l'utilisation des écrans ; cette utilisation peut nuire à la qualité des interactions, affectant la sensibilité et la réactivité parentales.

programme.title: Dis-moi pas!? La petite histoire des mots d'ici
programme.desc: Bonhomme Sept-Heures Plusieurs ont déjà entendu parler du bonhomme Sept-Heures et en ont même eu peur ; on demande si ce mot étrange vient vraiment de l'anglais "bonesetter."

programme.title: Parlons job
programme.desc: S01 E01 Tomber de haut En 1907, le pont de Québec s'effondre, causant la mort de 76 ouvriers ; perchés à des dizaines de mètres de hauteur, ces derniers n'avaient aucun équipement de sécurité pour se protéger.

programme.title: La disparition tranquille
programme.desc: La réalisatrice Flavie Payette-Renouf tente de comprendre le déclin du français au Québec. Elle veut faire la lumière sur ce qui menace vraiment notre langue, qui se fragilise sans cesse, tandis que l'anglais est de plus en plus attractif.

programme.title: Le tour du sujet ᴺᵉʷ
programme.desc: Survivre à son quotidien au travail Le docteur en psychologie et neuropsychologue Frédéric Banville nous présente son ouvrage "Comment survivre à son quotidien au travail."

programme.title: Dis-moi pas!? La petite histoire des mots d'ici
programme.desc: Tire On dénombre les multiples emplois du mot tire en français québécois ; à en juger par tous les sens qu'il a développés depuis sa traversée de l'Atlantique, ce mot a décidément tiré le bon numéro.

programme.title: La guerre des cerveaux
programme.desc: S01 E05 Faire face à l'avenir Raed Hammoud explore l'avenir de la guerre cognitive : une guerre invisible qui n'est plus un scénario de science-fiction.

programme.title: Dehors, l'école!
programme.desc: La formation des enseignant.e.s De plus en plus d'universités et de cégeps intègrent le plein air dans la formation des futurs enseignants ; ainsi, au Cégep de Granby, les étudiants en Techniques d'éducation spécialisée travaillent leur voix pour qu'elle porte davantage.

programme.title: Nordicité
programme.desc: Se jouer de l'hiver Du ski de fond à la pêche blanche, en passant par le hockey, le patin, les motoneiges et les festivals lumineux, le Québec transforme l'hiver en terrain de jeu.

programme.title: Bâtir ensemble
programme.desc: Formation et accompagnement Les coopératives permettent aux membres de prendre en charge leur logement ; comme la plupart des membres n'ont pas ou peu d'expérience de gestion, découvrez le rôle d'une équipe de formation dans les mois qui précèdent l'entrée dans leur logement.

programme.title: La guerre de l'Arctique
programme.desc: S01 E02 Notre rempart fond La frontière nord du Canada est à risque et la menace, militaire ou climatique, est à ses portes.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: Astronomie: la magnétosphère On appelle magnétosphère le champ magnétique qui entoure la Terre. Ce bouclier nous protège contre les bombardements d'énergie provenant du Soleil. C'est donc grâce à la magnétosphère que la vie sur Terre s'est développée.

programme.title: Les minutes du sexe
programme.desc: S01 E12 Faire l'amour dans l'eau On explore si on peut vraiment rester coincés en faisant l'amour dans l'eau.

programme.title: Hallucinant!
programme.desc: S01 E01 Cannabis d'hier et d'aujourd'hui On se demande si le cannabis d'aujourd'hui est différent de celui d'avant.

programme.title: Dis-moi pas!? La petite histoire des mots d'ici
programme.desc: Orignal L'orignal occupe une place à part dans le cœur de la population québécoise ; son nom apparaît d'ailleurs dans plus de 200 toponymes au Québec, et on croit même l'apercevoir sur les pièces de 25 cents.

programme.title: La clinique des mots
programme.desc: Le coeur Myocarde, tachycardie, échocardiographie : pour décoder ces mots prisés par les cardiologues, Jessica examinera le cœur sous toutes ses sutures, question d'en avoir le cœur net.

programme.title: L'architecture des possibles
programme.desc: S01 E05 Bâtir l'égalité Des logements adaptés à l'architecture guérisseuse, on traverse des lieux porteurs d'humanité où vieillir, aimer et se reconstruire deviennent possibles sans quitter son chez-soi ni son autonomie.

programme.title: Le sommeil en questions
programme.desc: S01 E01 Le changement d'heure, pour ou contre? On se demande quels sont les impacts du changement d'heure sur la santé et quels seraient les avantages de rester toute l'année à l'heure normale ; Jean-Daniel Doucet questionne le professeur émérite Joseph De Koninck à ce sujet.

programme.title: Les minutes du sexe
programme.desc: S01 E11 L'odeur du sexe féminin On explore les phénomènes biochimiques responsables de l'odeur du sexe féminin.

programme.title: Hallucinant!
programme.desc: S01 E02 Cannabis et alcool Le cannabis et l'alcool.

programme.title: De la scie au bistouri
programme.desc: S03 E03 Traumatologie Des premières amputations préhistoriques aux drones ambulanciers de demain, on explore l'univers haletant de la traumatologie.

programme.title: Générations sous pression
programme.desc: S01 E03 Le labyrinthe du diagnostic Quand les symptômes de bipolarité, trouble de personnalité limite, autisme, dépression et autres troubles se mêlent.

programme.title: Repenser le monde
programme.desc: S03 E03 A-t-on perdu confiance envers nos institutions? Plusieurs phénomènes laissent croire que la confiance envers les institutions démocratiques bat de l'aile ; les invités explorent les moyens pour restaurer cette confiance, qui est essentielle au bon fonctionnement de la démocratie.

programme.title: Le sommeil en questions
programme.desc: S01 E01 Le changement d'heure, pour ou contre? On se demande quels sont les impacts du changement d'heure sur la santé et quels seraient les avantages de rester toute l'année à l'heure normale ; Jean-Daniel Doucet questionne le professeur émérite Joseph De Koninck à ce sujet.

programme.title: 1995: espoirs et trahisons
programme.desc: S02 E03 L'heure des choix Le 30 octobre 1995, la tension est à son comble. Le Québec retient son souffle alors que les résultats du référendum sont dévoilés. Encore aujourd'hui, le résultat serré alimente la controverse.

programme.title: Les patientes
programme.desc: La santé mentale Au Canada, une femme sur cinq a une santé mentale perçue comme passable ou mauvaise. Est-ce attribuable à leur statut socio-économique, qui est globalement plus faible que celui des hommes ?

programme.title: Décarboner autrement
programme.desc: S01 E03 Les bioénergies L'hydrogène vert et les bioénergies sont des sources d'énergie méconnues qui pourraient aider le Québec à devenir carboneutre en 2050 ; 20 spécialistes du milieu se prononcent sur les meilleures décisions à prendre et les défis qui s'annoncent.

programme.title: Journée de prof
programme.desc: Johannes Frasnelli Johannes Frasnelli est un spécialiste de l'odorat, un sens important, selon lui, pour mesurer l'état de santé du cerveau ; dans son laboratoire de l'UQTR, il teste l'odorat de participants afin de tenter de détecter des signes précoces d'Alzheimer.

programme.title: Âmes soeurs
programme.desc: S01 E03 Habit d'Ursuline ou habit d'hospitalière Les Ursulines portent l'habit d'éducatrice et les Augustines portent l'habit d'hospitalière ; sous ces habits distincts se révèlent des liens tissés serrés et des partages de savoirs et d'expertises.

programme.title: Journée de prof
programme.desc: Christiane Bergeron-Leclerc Christiane Bergeron-Leclerc étudie la santé mentale de la population universitaire de l'UQAC; c'est pour elle que son équipe a créé la station Illumin, un espace pour se ressourcer et se détendre.

programme.title: The Terror - Infamy: The Weak Are Meat
programme.desc: Chester, in search of a better life, is treated with hostility by his fellow Americans; Luz hopes to be accepted by Henry and Asako in their new home as the Japanese American community celebrates Obon, a festival to commemorate the dead.

programme.title: The Terror - Infamy: Shatter Like a Pearl
programme.desc: The Japanese Americans are forced to undertake a humiliating exercise that divides the community; Chester comes face to face with a man who forces him to question his very nature; Luz, stricken by grief, is forced to make an important choice.

programme.title: The Terror - Infamy: Taizo
programme.desc: A story of the past provides insight into the present evil that stalks the Terminal Islanders; Chester returns home to his family; Henry and Asako are faced with a difficult decision.

programme.title: The Terror - Infamy: My Perfect World
programme.desc: The Nakayamas have been torn apart; Chester searches for the person he believes can help, by any means necessary; an outbreak in the community forces Amy to act, though she's caught between doing what she's told and doing what's right.

programme.title: The Terror - Infamy: My Sweet Boy
programme.desc: Chester and Luz have reached a turning point in their relationship; Amy must take matters into her own hands as she's tormented by a powerful nemesis; Chester meets a boy who gives him answers.

programme.title: The Terror - Infamy: Come and Get Me
programme.desc: The Terminal Islanders return home to find that things have changed since they left; the Nakayamas, still tense from the pain they've inflicted on one another, must come together to battle the spirit that threatens their future.

programme.title: The Terror - Infamy: Into the Afterlife
programme.desc: Henry and Asako look to the past to provide answers to their current turmoil; Chester and Luz grapple with their identities in hopes of saving those who are dearest to them; Amy and Yamato-san struggle to once again assimilate into American life.

programme.title: Mid90s
programme.desc: In the 1990s Los Angeles, a 13-year-old spends his summer navigating between a troubled home life and a crew of new friends he meets at a skate shop. (Comedy drama) - 2018

programme.title: Hidden Figures
programme.desc: Three brilliant African American women at NASA, Katherine Johnson, Dorothy Vaughan and Mary Jackson, serve as the brains behind one of the greatest operations in history, the launch of astronaut John Glenn into orbit, a stunning achievement that restored the nation's confidence, turned around the Space Race and galvanized the world. (Historical drama, Docudrama, Biography) - 2016

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy, Historical drama) - 2010

programme.title: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown. (Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2018

programme.title: A History of Violence
programme.desc: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

programme.title: Atomic Blonde
programme.desc: With the Berlin Wall about to fall, an elite MI6 spy travels into the heart of the city to retrieve a priceless dossier and take down a ruthless espionage ring. - 2017

programme.title: Room
programme.desc: Held captive for years in an enclosed space, a woman and her young son finally gain their freedom, allowing the boy to experience the outside world for the first time. - 2015

programme.title: Papillon
programme.desc: The epic story of Henri Papillon Charrière, framed for murder and condemned to life in the notorious penal colony on Devil's Island. Determined to regain his freedom, Papillon forms an alliance with counterfeiter Louis Dega to finance his escape. - 2017

programme.title: Stonewall
programme.desc: Kicked out by his parents, a gay teenager (Jeremy Irvine) leaves small-town Indiana for New York's Greenwich Village, where growing discrimination against the LGBT community leads to riots on June 28, 1969. - 2015

programme.title: The Hobbit
programme.desc: An animated adaptation of J.R.R. Tolkien's tale of the adventures of a hobbit on a quest to regain a dwarf king's gold. - 1977

programme.desc: Delving into the mythological, including dragons, mermaids, and unicorns -- alongside examinations of natural world beasts, such as vervet monkeys, narwhals, and manatees; Stephen Fry travels far and wide to learn about such animals.

programme.title: Epic
programme.desc: Magically transported to a secret realm, a teenage girl (Amanda Seyfried) joins an ongoing battle between the forces of good, which keep the natural world vital, and the forces of evil, which want to destroy it. - 2013

programme.title: Beasts of the Southern Wild
programme.desc: The father of an intrepid youngster (Quvenzhané Wallis) prepares her for the end of the world, when melting ice caps release fearsome beasts, called aurochs, and rising floodwaters threaten to engulf their Delta home. - 2012

programme.title: Rampage
programme.desc: When three different animals become infected with a dangerous pathogen, a primatologist and a geneticist team up to stop them from destroying Chicago. - 2018

programme.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri
programme.desc: After a 50-year-old woman's (Frances McDormand) daughter is murdered, she confronts the police (Caleb Landry Jones, Kerry Condon) in her town, using the billboards on the outskirts of town to begin a smear campaign against them. - 2017

programme.title: Spring Breakers
programme.desc: Four college friends (Vanessa Hudgens, Selena Gomez, Ashley Benson, Rachel Korine) are arrested after robbing a restaurant to fund their spring-break trip. They land in more trouble when a drug and arms dealer bails them out to do some dirty work. - 2012

programme.title: Get Him to the Greek
programme.desc: A record-company employee (Jonah Hill) has just a few days to get a boozy British rock star (Russell Brand) to Hollywood for a big comeback concert. - 2010

programme.title: The Perfect Match
programme.desc: Charlie (Terrence J) is a charming playboy who doesn't believe in serious relationships. His best friends bet him that if he commits to one woman for one month, he's bound to fall in love. Charlie accepts the seemingly easy challenge, but wasn't expecting to cross paths with the beautiful and mysterious Eva (Cassie Ventura). When Charlie coaxes her into a casual affair, Eva turns the tables on him, forcing the lifelong bachelor to question whether he wants more than just a one-night stand. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

programme.title: MacGruber
programme.desc: In the decade since his fiancée was killed, an Army Ranger, Green Beret and Navy SEAL rolled into one has sworn off fighting crime, preferring instead to rock his mullet as a man of peace. But when his sworn enemy, Dieter Von Cunth, steals a nuclear warhead, only MacGruber and his crack team of experts are equal to the task of bringing the villain to justice. (Comedy, Action) - 2010

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1995

programme.title: Mojave
programme.desc: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home. (Thriller) - 2015

programme.title: Beirut
programme.desc: In the 1980s Beirut, Mason Skiles is a former U.S. diplomat who is called back into service to save a colleague from the group that is possibly responsible for his own family's death. Meanwhile, a CIA field agent who is working undercover at the American embassy is tasked with keeping Mason alive and ensuring that the mission is a success. (Thriller, Drama) - 2018

To revitalize their marriages, their wives grant them one week to do whatever they please, no questions asked. At first, the deal sounds like a dream come true, but as the week marches on, the two friends discover that their expectations are wildly out of sync with reality. (Comedy) - 2011

Hostetler thinks his wife, Cathleen (Catherine Zeta-Jones), is having an affair and that it may hurt his chances for re-election. However, a bigger scandal than expected pulls in Billy right at the start of his investigation. Double-crossed by the mayor, Billy begins a relentless quest for justice. (Crime drama, Thriller, Action) - 2013

programme.title: The Alto Knights

Once the best of friends, petty jealousies and a series of betrayals place them on a deadly collision course that reshapes organized crime forever. (Crime drama) - 2025

programme.title: The Nun II
programme.desc: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak. (Horror, Thriller) - 2023

programme.title: Opus
programme.desc: A journalist is invited to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by the star's cult of sycophants, she gets caught in the middle of his twisted plan. (Thriller, Horror, Comedy) - 2025

programme.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
programme.desc: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1995

programme.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
programme.desc: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former babysitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1998

programme.title: Halloween: Resurrection
programme.desc: He's back for more... When a group of teens wins a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. But things go frightfully wrong and the game turns into a struggle to make it out of the house alive. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2002

programme.title: Trap
programme.desc: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert. (Thriller) - 2024

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2019

programme.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
programme.desc: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

programme.title: Black Adam
programme.desc: In ancient Kahndaq, Teth Adam was bestowed the almighty powers of the gods. After using these powers for vengeance, he was imprisoned, becoming Black Adam. Nearly 5,000 years have passed, and Black Adam has gone from man to myth to legend. Now free, his unique form of justice, born out of rage, is challenged by modern-day heroes who form the Justice Society: Hawkman, Dr. Fate, Atom Smasher and Cyclone. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2022

programme.title: Colette
programme.desc: After moving to Paris, author Sidonie-Gabrielle Colette agrees to ghostwrite a semi-autobiographical novel for her husband. Its success soon inspires her to fight for creative ownership and overcome the societal constraints of the early 20th century. (Biography, Historical drama) - 2018

programme.title: The Dilemma
programme.desc: Longtime friends Ronny (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Kevin James) are partners in an auto-design firm. They are hard at work on a presentation for a dream project that would really launch their company. Then Ronny spots Nick's wife out with another man, and in the process of investigating the possible affair, he learns that Nick has a few secrets of his own. As the presentation nears, Ronny agonizes over what might happen if the truth gets out. (Comedy) - 2011

programme.title: Contagion
programme.desc: When Beth Emhoff returns to Minnesota from a Hong Kong business trip, she attributes the malaise she feels to jet lag. However, two days later, Beth is dead, and doctors tell her shocked husband that they have no idea what killed her. Soon, many others start to exhibit the same symptoms, and a global pandemic explodes. Doctors try to contain the lethal microbe, but society begins to collapse as a blogger fans the flames of paranoia. (Thriller, Drama) - 2011

programme.title: Ocean's Eight
programme.desc: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2018

programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact. (Science fiction, Comedy) - 2025

programme.title: The Switch
programme.desc: Neurotic Wally Mars has one bright spot in his life: his friendship with Kassie. When Kassie announces her intention to become pregnant using a sperm donor, Wally thinks he will be the lucky guy, but Kassie has someone else in mind. While drunk at Kassie's insemination party, Wally substitutes his sperm for the donor's, then passes out, remembering nothing. Seven years later, Wally meets Kassie's son, who seems oddly familiar to him. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

programme.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
programme.desc: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (Romantic comedy) - 2011

programme.title: Tyler Perry's Madea's Witness Protection
programme.desc: For years, mild-mannered Wall Street banker George Needleman (Eugene Levy) has meandered through life oblivious to his family's dysfunction and his company's malfeasance, but he's forced to wake up when he learns that he's been framed in a mob-backed Ponzi scheme. Placed under federal protection, George and his family are shipped down South to Madea's (Tyler Perry) house, where the no-nonsense matriarch whips them all into shape using her special brand of tough love. (Comedy, Crime drama) - 2012

programme.title: Dr. Seuss' Horton Hears a Who!
programme.desc: Animated elephant Horton finds a speck of dust floating in the Jungle of Nool. Upon investigation of the speck, Horton discovers the tiny city of Whoville and its residents, the Whos, which he can hear but cannot see. Horton forms a friendship with the mayor of Whoville, Ned McDodd, and promises to transport Whoville to safety. However, Horton encounters opposition from his jungle neighbors, who don't want to believe in the existence of Whoville. (Animated, Children, Adventure) - 2008

programme.title: Isle of Dogs
programme.desc: When, by executive decree, all the canine pets of Megasaki City are exiled to a vast garbage-dump called Trash Island, 12-year-old Atari sets off alone in a miniature Junior-Turbo Prop and flies across the river in search of his bodyguard-dog, Spots. There, with the assistance of a pack of newly-found mongrel friends, he begins an epic journey that will decide the fate and future of the entire Prefecture. (Animated, Comedy, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 2018

programme.title: Masterminds
programme.desc: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him. (Comedy, Action) - 2016

programme.title: Space Jam
programme.desc: Swackhammer (Danny DeVito), an evil alien theme park owner, needs a new attraction at Moron Mountain. When his gang, the Nerdlucks, heads to Earth to kidnap Bugs Bunny (Billy West) and the Looney Tunes, Bugs challenges them to a basketball game to determine their fate. The aliens agree, but they steal the powers of NBA basketball players, including Larry Bird (Larry Bird) and Charles Barkley (Charles Barkley) -- so Bugs gets some help from superstar Michael Jordan (Michael Jordan). (Family, Comedy, Adventure, Animated) - 1996

programme.title: Teen Titans GO! See Space Jam
programme.desc: The Teen Titans gang crosses paths with the Nerdlucks from Space Jam. (Animated, Action, Adventure, Comedy) - 2021

programme.title: Space Jam: A New Legacy
programme.desc: Superstar LeBron James and his young son, Dom, get trapped in digital space by a rogue AI. To get home safely, LeBron teams up with Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and the rest of the Looney Tunes gang for a high-stakes basketball game against the AI's digitized champions of the court -- a powered-up roster called the Goon Squad. (Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy, Animated) - 2021

programme.title: A Thousand Words
programme.desc: Jack McCall (Eddie Murphy) is a selfish literary agent whose fast-talking ways allow him to close any deal. His next target is New Age guru Dr. Sinja (Cliff Curtis), but the savvy doctor sees right through Jack. A magical tree appears in Jack's yard, and, according to Dr. Sinja, the tree and Jack are connected; every time Jack says a word, a leaf falls from the tree. When the last leaf drops, Jack will die. With just a thousand leaves left, Jack must learn to curb his speech, or he's a goner. (Comedy) - 2012

programme.title: The Man Who Invented Christmas
programme.desc: In 1843 London, author Charles Dickens finds himself in financial trouble after writing three unsuccessful novels in a row. Desperate for a hit, Dickens relies on real-life inspiration and his vivid imagination to bring Ebenezer Scrooge, Tiny Tim and other classic characters to life in A Christmas Carol, forever changing the holiday season into the celebration known today. (Holiday, Historical drama, Biography) - 2017

Bud comes to believe that Prancer may actually be magical, but Gloria fears his theory will send him straight to a retirement home. They try to keep the secret while figuring out why the reindeer has appeared, and longstanding rifts within the family are healed along the way. (Family, Holiday, Drama, Fantasy) - 2022

programme.title: Brian Banks
programme.desc: The inspirational true story of Brian Banks, an all-American high school football star who finds his life upended when he's wrongly convicted of a crime he didn't commit. Despite the lack of evidence, Banks gets railroaded through a broken justice system and sentenced to a decade of prison and probation. Years later, with the support of Justin Brooks and the California Innocence Project, Banks fights to reclaim his life and fulfill his dreams of playing in the NFL. (Biography, Drama) - 2018

programme.desc: Angela develops a friendship with a mysterious woman named Katie and offers her a job as a live-in nanny. The natural bond soon turns into a dangerous obsession as Katie becomes overly attached to the family's young daughter. Enduring lies and manipulations, Angela and her husband realize that sweet Katie is actually trying to destroy their family from within. (Thriller, Drama) - 2017

programme.title: Robin Hood

He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" - hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter - features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel - hoping to get as close to $1 as possible - in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes. (Game show) - 1972

programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: Shallow, rich and socially successful Cher (Alicia Silverstone) is at the top of her Beverly Hills high school's pecking scale. Seeing herself as a matchmaker, Cher first coaxes two teachers into dating each other. Emboldened by her success, she decides to give hopelessly klutzy new student Tai (Brittany Murphy) a makeover. When Tai becomes more popular than she is, Cher realizes that her disapproving ex-stepbrother (Paul Rudd) was right about how misguided she was -- and falls for him. (Comedy, Romance) - 1995

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady Heron enrolls at North Shore High School near Chicago after living in Africa. She interacts with Regina George, a prominent student who previously dated Aaron Samuels. Conflict arises when Heron develops an interest in Samuels, leading George to feign a friendship with Heron while attempting to maintain her relationship with Samuels. Both students engage in competitive social behavior that affects the student body. (Comedy) - 2004

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show -- now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turns to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system. (Comedy, Science fiction, Adventure, Action, Fantasy) - 1999

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When a man (Christopher Lloyd) claiming to be Fester, the missing brother of Gomez Addams (Raul Julia), arrives at the Addams' home, the family is thrilled. However, Morticia (Anjelica Huston) begins to suspect the man is a fraud, since he cannot recall details of Fester's life. With the help of lawyer Tully Alford (Dan Hedaya), Fester manages to get the Addams clan evicted from their home. Gomez realizes the two men are conspiring to swindle the Addams fortune and that he must challenge Fester. (Fantasy, Dark comedy) - 1991

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: The members of the odd Addams Family are up to more macabre antics in this sequel. This time around, Gomez Addams (Raul Julia) and his wife, Morticia (Anjelica Huston), are celebrating the arrival of a baby boy. But siblings Wednesday (Christina Ricci) and Pugsley (Jimmy Workman) are none too happy about the new addition, and try their best to eliminate the infant. When nanny Debbie Jellinsky (Joan Cusack) appears to keep the kids in line, her presence leads to an unexpected treacherous twist. (Dark comedy, Fantasy) - 1993

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: The four nations of Air, Water, Earth and Fire lived in harmony until the Fire Nation declared war. A century later, there is still no end in sight to the destruction, then, an Avatar named Aang (Noah Ringer) discovers that he has the power to control the four elements. He joins forces with Katara (Nicola Peltz), a Waterbender, and her brother, Sokka, to restore balance and harmony to their world. (Fantasy, Adventure) - 2010

programme.title: Good Burger
programme.desc: Teen misfits (Kel Mitchell, Kenan Thompson) at a modest burger joint face competition from a hamburger emporium across the street. (Comedy) - 1997

programme.title: Good Burger 2
programme.desc: Dexter Reed and cashier Ed reunite at fast-food restaurant Good Burger with a hilarious new group of employees. (Comedy) - 2023

programme.title: The Rugrats Movie
programme.desc: This animated comedy finds Tommy Pickles (E.G. Daily) trying to return his baby brother to the hospital after being warned by his mean-spirited friend, Angelica (Cheryl Chase), that once his new sibling is born his parents won't care about him. But, soon after they embark on the mission, Tommy and his friends lose their way in the woods and get into trouble with a pack of wild monkeys who have escaped from the circus. The kids begin to think that maybe things weren't so bad at home after all. (Animated, Children, Adventure) - 1998

programme.title: Rugrats in Paris: The Movie
programme.desc: In the long-running animated series' second feature film, the focus is on the show's perennial second banana, Chuckie (Christine Cavanaugh). Dads Stu (Jack Riley) and Chaz (Michael Bell) are unexpectedly sent to Euro-Reptarland in Paris, where the animatronic dinosaurs they built for the amusement park are malfunctioning, much to the displeasure of manager Coco La Bouche (Susan Sarandon). When the dislikable Coco gets interested in the single Chaz, Chuckie and his friends swing into action. (Animated, Children, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2000

programme.title: Rugrats Go Wild
programme.desc: Chuckie (Nancy Cartwright) and Tommy (Elizabeth Daily) find themselves stranded with their parents on a remote island. By coincidence, the adventurous Thornberrys are also exploring the island. So, with his talking dog, Spike (Bruce Willis), in tow, Tommy takes Chuckie on a walkabout meant to find Donnie Thornberry (Flea) and his sister, Eliza (Lacey Chabert). They'll need to be careful, though, as exotic leopard Siri (Chrissie Hynde) is hungry and not afraid to make her presence known. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2003

programme.title: Hey Arnold! The Movie
programme.desc: Arnold (Spencer Klein) and his pal, Gerald (Jamil Walker Smith), learn their beloved neighborhood is about to be torn down by a greedy developer named Scheck (Paul Sorvino) to build a mall. While the adults come up with a dodgy scheme, the friends try a more practical approach to the problem with the help of Helga (Francesca Marie Smith). The kids discover their neighborhood was designated as a historical landmark, but they must prove it before Scheck moves in with his crew. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2002

programme.title: Hey Arnold! The Jungle Movie
programme.desc: Arnold and his friends find nonstop adventure when they travel to San Lorenzo, Argentina, to find his missing parents. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2017

programme.title: The Wild Thornberrys Movie
programme.desc: The Wild Thornberrys feature film finds one of America's favorite animated families going on wild adventures around the world. Now, 12-year-old Eliza is in Africa where she meets a mysterious shaman who grants her the power to talk to animals. But there's a catch -- if she reveals her gift she will lose it forever. One day Eliza discovers that poachers plan to kill an elephant herd with an electrified fence and she and Darwin, her pet chimp, must stop them. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2002

programme.title: Zoey 102
programme.desc: Zoey Brooks is still trying to figure out life and love, this time in her 20s. Zoey and Chase did not end up in Hawaii that summer and haven't heard from each other since. When close friends Quinn and Logan announce they're getting married, Zoey and Chase find themselves in the wedding party. (Family, Comedy drama) - 2023

programme.title: Honor Society
programme.desc: Honor is an ambitious high school senior whose sole focus is getting into an Ivy League college, assuming she can first score the coveted recommendation from her guidance counselor, Mr. Calvin. (Comedy) - 2022

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: New student Cady Heron gets welcomed into the top of the social food chain by an elite group of popular girls called the Plastics, ruled by the conniving queen bee Regina George. However, when Cady makes the major misstep of falling for Regina's ex-boyfriend, she soon finds herself caught in their crosshairs. (Musical comedy) - 2024

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Diary
programme.desc: At the start of the New Year, 32-year-old Bridget (Renée Zellweger) decides it's time to take control of her life -- and start keeping a diary. Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life. (Romantic comedy) - 2001

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue. (Romantic comedy) - 2004

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
programme.desc: Breaking up with Mark Darcy (Colin Firth) leaves Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) over 40 and single again. Feeling that she has everything under control, Jones decides to focus on her career as a top news producer. Suddenly, her love life comes back from the dead when she meets a dashing and handsome American named Jack (Patrick Dempsey). Things couldn't be better, until Bridget discovers that she is pregnant. Now, the befuddled mom-to-be must figure out if the proud papa is Mark or Jack. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 2016

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
programme.desc: Breaking up with Mark Darcy (Colin Firth) leaves Bridget Jones (Renée Zellweger) over 40 and single again. Feeling that she has everything under control, Jones decides to focus on her career as a top news producer. Suddenly, her love life comes back from the dead when she meets a dashing and handsome American named Jack (Patrick Dempsey). Things couldn't be better, until Bridget discovers that she is pregnant. Now, the befuddled mom-to-be must figure out if the proud papa is Mark or Jack. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 2016

programme.title: What Women Want
programme.desc: Nick Marshall (Mel Gibson) gets a whole new outlook on life when a fluke accident gives him the ability to read women's minds. At first, this "gift" provides Nick with way too much information, but he begins to realize that he can use it to good effect, especially when it comes to outwitting his new boss, Darcy Maguire (Helen Hunt). (Romantic comedy) - 2000

programme.title: She's the Man
programme.desc: Romantic complications ensue when a student poses as her twin brother and replaces him at his boarding school. (Romantic comedy) - 2006

programme.title: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
programme.desc: An advice columnist, Andie Anderson (Kate Hudson), tries pushing the boundaries of what she can write about in her new piece about how to get a man to leave you in 10 days. Her editor, Lana (Bebe Neuwirth), loves it, and Andie goes off to find a man she can use for the experiment. Enter executive Ben Berry (Matthew McConaughey), who is so confident in his romantic prowess that he thinks he can make any woman fall in love with him in 10 days. When Andie and Ben meet, their plans backfire. (Romantic comedy) - 2003

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. They hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to assume the mantle of responsibility and get his own place. (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Romance) - 2006

programme.title: 80 for Brady
programme.desc: Four best friends live life to the fullest when they embark on a wild trip to see their hero, Tom Brady, play in the 2017 Super Bowl. (Comedy) - 2023

programme.title: Three Months
programme.desc: On the eve of his high school graduation, Caleb learns he's been exposed to HIV. While he waits three months for his results, he finds love in the most unlikely of places. (Comedy drama) - 2022

programme.title: The Lost City
programme.desc: Reclusive author Loretta Sage writes about exotic places in her popular adventure novels that feature a handsome cover model named Alan. While on tour promoting her new book with Alan, Loretta gets kidnapped by an eccentric billionaire who hopes she can lead him to an ancient city's lost treasure from her latest story. Determined to prove he can be a hero in real life and not just on the pages of her books, Alan sets off to rescue her. (Romantic comedy, Adventure, Action) - 2022

programme.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
programme.desc: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers embark on an epic quest to retrieve a lost relic, but things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people. (Fantasy, Adventure, Action, Comedy) - 2023

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Spawned from a lab experiment gone awry, teenage terrapins Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello and Raphael live in the sewers beneath New York. Although their rodent sensei, Splinter, advises against showing themselves above ground, the justice-loving, pizza-eating brothers can't stand idly by while evil Shredder and his minions terrorize the city. With help from intrepid reporter April O'Neil (Megan Fox) and her cameraman (Will Arnett), the Turtles set out to save New York. (Action, Adventure, Comedy) - 2014

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The turtles face a new challenge when Shredder escapes from custody and joins forces with Baxter Stockman, a mad scientist who plans to use a serum to take over the world. Along for the ride are Bebop and Rocksteady, two dimwitted henchmen who provide plenty of muscle. Luckily, the turtles have their own allies in April O'Neil, Vernon Fenwick and Casey Jones, a hockey-masked vigilante. As the pizza-loving heroes prepare for battle, the notorious Krang also emerges to pose an even greater threat. (Action, Adventure, Comedy) - 2016

programme.title: The Killer Is Loose
programme.desc: Humble bank teller Leon Poole (Wendell Corey) participates in a heist that doesn't go as planned. When police surround his apartment, there's a shoot-out, during which Detective Sam Wagner (Joseph Cotten) unwittingly kills Poole's wife. Poole is subsequently captured and jailed, but three years later he's back out on the street and hell-bent on revenge. Wanting the punishment to fit the crime, he vows that he won't kill Wagner -- just his wife (Rhonda Fleming). (Thriller) - 1956

programme.title: The Young Savages
programme.desc: After a Puerto Rican teen is murdered by three white adolescents, the case comes to Assistant District Attorney Hank Bell (Burt Lancaster). Realizing that he used to date the mother (Shelley Winters) of one of the suspects, he wonders if the boy is his son. Despite Bell's personal involvement, the district attorney (Edward Andrews) keeps him on the case. However, as Bell discovers street gang involvement in the case, he and his wife (Dina Merrill) begin to face physical threats. (Drama, Thriller) - 1961

programme.title: The Large Rope
programme.desc: An innocent ex-con becomes a two-time loser when he finds himself the scapegoat in the murder of a disreputable female. (Crime drama) - 1953

programme.title: A Story of David: The Hunted
programme.desc: Renowned for his courageous deeds as a youth when he slew Goliath, David (Jeff Chandler) inadvertently incurs the wrath of King Saul (Basil Sydney), who is jealous of the hero's popularity. In order to provide peace of mind for the Israelite king, Saul's scheming counselor, Doeg (Peter Arne), encourages the ruler to have David killed. David, aided by his friend Jonathan (David Knight), who is Saul's own son, attempts to survive without overtly clashing with his own people. (Historical drama) - 1960

programme.title: The Sharkfighters
programme.desc: Navy pilot Ben Staves (Victor Mature) arrives at a research facility on a small Caribbean island to help develop a shark repellent for use by sailors and downed airmen. Partnered with scientists Leonard Evans (Philip Coolidge) and Harold Duncan (James Olson), Staves provides valuable information about his own time stranded in the ocean. But his impatient desire to finish the project quickly conflicts with the researchers' methodical precision, with potentially deadly results. (Action) - 1956

programme.title: Time Limit
programme.desc: Maj. Cargill (Richard Basehart) is accused of aiding his captors while held in a North Korean prison during the war and brought up on charges of treason. Col. William Edwards (Richard Widmark) has been assigned to defend the major in his court-martial, but it's not an easy case for the colonel. More than a dozen witnesses are prepared to testify against Cargill, and the major himself admits his guilt. But Edwards begins to suspect that the major is innocent and covering up for someone else. (Drama) - 1957

programme.title: The Pride and the Passion
programme.desc: A British naval officer (Cary Grant) and a Spanish guerrilla (Frank Sinatra) salvage a huge cannon to use against Napoleon. - 1957

programme.title: Taras Bulba
programme.desc: A Cossack chieftain (Yul Brynner) makes war, as his reckless son (Tony Curtis) makes love to a young Polish noblewoman (Christine Kaufmann). - 1962

programme.title: Alexander the Great
programme.desc: Aristotle's student, Philip of Macedonia's (Fredric March) son, Alexander (Richard Burton) wants to rule the fourth-century B.C. world. - 1956

programme.title: A Hole in the Head
programme.desc: A Miami widower (Frank Sinatra) has big dreams, a son, a run-down hotel and a rich New York brother (Edward G. Robinson) who does not approve. - 1959

programme.title: A Story of David: The Hunted
programme.desc: Saul (Basil Sydney), king of Israel, turns against the shepherd David (Jeff Chandler), according to the Old Testament. - 1960

programme.title: The Sharkfighters
programme.desc: Navy personnel and marine biologists attempt to perfect a shark repellent in time to save pilots forced to land at sea. - 1956

programme.title: Time Limit
programme.desc: An Army colonel (Richard Widmark) seeks the truth about a major (Richard Basehart) accused of treason for when he was a POW in Korea. - 1957

programme.title: The Pride and the Passion
programme.desc: A British naval officer (Cary Grant) and a Spanish guerrilla (Frank Sinatra) salvage a huge cannon to use against Napoleon. - 1957

programme.title: Taras Bulba
programme.desc: A Cossack chieftain (Yul Brynner) makes war, as his reckless son (Tony Curtis) makes love to a young Polish noblewoman (Christine Kaufmann). - 1962

programme.title: Alexander the Great
programme.desc: Aristotle's student, Philip of Macedonia's (Fredric March) son, Alexander (Richard Burton) wants to rule the fourth-century B.C. world. - 1956

programme.title: Violent Playground
programme.desc: Sgt. Truman (Stanley Baker), a policeman who deals with juvenile delinquents, visits the Murphy household after a theft by the young twins, Mary and Patrick. There he meets their older sister, Cathie (Anne Heywood), and soon begins a romantic involvement with her. However, Cathie's brother, Johnnie (David McCallum), is the leader of an infamous local gang, and doesn't like to see his sister with a cop. Gradually, Truman starts to see a link between Johnnie and a string of local arsons. (Drama) - 1958

programme.title: The 7th Dawn
programme.desc: After World War II, Ferris (William Holden) remains in Malaya and becomes a successful businessman. He enjoys a quiet existence with his Malayan girlfriend, Dhana (Capucine), although a politician's daughter named Candace (Susannah York) also fancies him. Soon, Ferris encounters a man named Ng (Tetsuro Tamba), who served with him during the war and is now a communist committed to revolution for the guerillas. After Dhana is arrested, Ferris makes a deal to track down Ng in order to save her. (Action) - 1964

programme.title: Shake Hands With the Devil
programme.desc: In 1921, Kerry O'Shea (Don Murray), an American medical student living in Ireland, learns that his esteemed professor, Sean Lenihan (James Cagney), is also a leader in Ireland's rebel army. Even though Kerry's father and roommate have both been killed by British troops, he refuses to join the Irish rebellion. However, after Kerry is unjustly imprisoned and tortured by the British "Black and Tans" special forces, he fully commits himself to the cause of Irish freedom. (Drama) - 1959

programme.title: Killer's Kiss
programme.desc: Davey Gordon (Jamie Smith), a New York City boxer aging out of his profession, meets dancer Gloria Price (Irene Kane), and they begin a romance. However, their budding relationship is interrupted by Gloria's violent boss, Vincent Rapallo (Frank Silvera), who has eyes for his employee. The two decide to skip town, but before they can, Vincent and his thugs abduct Gloria, and Davey is forced to search for her among the most squalid corners of the city, with his enemy hiding in the shadows. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1955

programme.title: Deadly Impact
programme.desc: After a brilliant killer once again resurfaces, a cop (Sean Patrick Flanery) joins forces with the FBI to bring the psychopath to justice. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 2010

programme.title: Born Losers
programme.desc: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy. (Crime drama) - 1967

programme.title: How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying
programme.desc: J. Pierpont Finch is a lowly window cleaner with dreams of making it big in the business world. After finding a copy of the book "How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying," Finch decides to apply the tactics in the book to his own life. Soon, he's working as a mail-room clerk at the World Wide Wicket Company and quickly fighting his way up the corporate ladder with relative ease in this quirky musical based on the hit Broadway production. (Musical comedy) - 1967

programme.title: The Quiet American
programme.desc: During the 1950s, Thomas Fowler is a British journalist stationed in Vietnam to cover the growing unrest. While in the country, he begins an extramarital affair with a beautiful young Vietnamese woman, Phuong. However, their romance is interrupted by Alden Pyle, an idealistic American economist in Vietnam on an aid mission. When Pyle proposes to Phuong, Fowler accuses him of secretly dealing weapons. (Drama) - 1958

programme.title: Trapeze
programme.desc: Mike Ribble (Burt Lancaster) is a hard-drinking tent pitcher. His career as a famous trapeze artist ended years ago after attempting a triple somersault gave him a permanent limp. Young acrobat Tino (Tony Curtis) tracks Mike down and asks him to teach him the dangerous stunt. Mike first refuses but is convinced by his ex-lover, Rosa (Katy Jurado). Mike and Tino have a shot at the big time, but the two men are driven apart by the scheming of Lola (Gina Lollobrigida), an Italian trampolinist. (Drama) - 1956

programme.title: Have You Seen My Son?
programme.desc: A woman (Lisa Hartman Black) crosses state and national borders to find her ailing son, kidnapped by her ex-husband (Jameson Parker). (Thriller) - 1996

programme.title: Cop Hater
programme.desc: During a blisteringly hot summer, tensions on the city streets are already high when a cop is inexplicably gunned down, with no leads to go on. Two officers from the dead man's precinct, police Detectives Carelli and Maguire, are put in charge of the murder investigation but are shocked when the victim's partner is killed similarly. The detectives then realize they're dealing with a sadistic cop hater, and they could be next on his hit list. (Mystery) - 1958

programme.title: The Square Peg
programme.desc: A World War II street laborer (Norman Wisdom) uses his resemblance to a Nazi officer when he is drafted into the British army and captured by German troops. (Comedy) - 1958

programme.title: We Still Kill the Old Way
programme.desc: A teacher (Gian Maria Volonte) falls for a woman (Irene Papas) whose husband was recently murdered on a hunting trip. (Crime drama) - 1967

programme.title: Two for the Seesaw
programme.desc: After leaving his wife, lawyer Jerry Ryan (Robert Mitchum) moves from Omaha, Neb., to New York City to start a new life. While studying for the New York Bar Examination and working to finalize his divorce, Ryan meets dancer Gittel Mosca (Shirley MacLaine), and the two begin a cautious courtship. However, Ryan feels that he must come to terms with his failed marriage and overcome his lingering attachment to his ex-wife before he can redefine himself and embrace his budding romance. (Drama) - 1962

programme.title: Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: In this classic Shakespearean story, long-time adversarial families the Capulets and the Montagues engage in a street brawl, which results in a decree declaring that the next conflict will be punishable by death. But during an opulent masked ball, young Romeo Montague (Laurence Harvey) falls in love with Juliet Capulet (Susan Shentall). With the family feud reignited, Juliet's cousin kills Romeo's friend, Mercutio (Ubaldo Zollo), placing the young lovers in grave danger. (Romance) - 1954

programme.title: Melody Parade
programme.desc: An ambitious busboy (Eddie Quillan) and a nightclub owner (Tim Ryan) facing bankruptcy mistake a performer for a potential sponsor. (Musical) - 1943

programme.title: Happy Anniversary
programme.desc: On their 13th wedding anniversary, long-simmering tensions between Manhattan businessman Chris Walters (David Niven) and his homemaker wife, Alice (Mitzi Gaynor), explode with the arrival of a new television set from Alice's well-meaning but meddlesome parents (Loring Smith, Phyllis Povah). Tired of Chris's explosive temper and embarrassed by his drunken admission to her parents that they had been intimate prior to their wedding night, Alice debates leaving her husband. (Comedy) - 1959

programme.title: Never on Sunday
programme.desc: Free spirit and prostitute Ilya (Melina Mercouri) lives in a Greek port city. Open and amiable, she makes friends often and easily. She encounters Homer Thrace (Jules Dassin), a vacationing American who is obsessed with ancient Greek culture. Homer feels that modern Greece is a shadow of its former self, and he believes that Ilya is a prime example of contemporary decadence. He makes it his goal to amend Ilya's easygoing ways, but she has stronger principles than Homer expected. (Drama) - 1960

programme.title: The Knack... and How to Get It
programme.desc: Desperate to improve his luck with women, London schoolteacher Colin (Michael Crawford) enlists his artist roommate, Tom (Donal Donnelly), to help drag a brass bed back to their flat. Along the way they meet Nancy (Rita Tushingham), a new girl in town, who follows them home. There they encounter Tolen (Ray Brooks), the third roommate and a consummate lady-killer. He tries to help Colin seduce Nancy, but ends up whisking her away on his motorcycle instead, and Colin is determined to get her back. (Comedy) - 1965

programme.title: The First Time
programme.desc: Searching for a Canadian bordello leads three teenage boys to a British beauty who scares them. (Comedy) - 1969

programme.title: The Happy Thieves
programme.desc: An art thief (Rex Harrison), his lover (Rita Hayworth) and a forger (Joseph Wiseman) plot to steal a Goya painting from the Prado museum in Madrid. (Comedy drama) - 1962

programme.title: Namu, the Killer Whale
programme.desc: After fishermen off the coast of Washington state slay a killer whale, the dead animal's mate founders in the coastal waters. Marine biologist Hank Donner (Robert Lansing) finds the surviving whale and forges a bond with the animal while documenting his scientific observations. Though some believe killer whales are vicious, local woman Kate Rand (Lee Meriwether) and her young daughter, Lisa (Robin Mattson), warm to Hank's new pal, even as fishermen state their plans to kill the whale. (Children, Docudrama) - 1966

programme.title: Moulin Rouge
programme.desc: Visually exquisite biopic of Toulouse-Lautrec, the crippled painter whose work perfectly captured the spirit of Bohemian Paris in the naughty 1890s. Portrayed as an embittered loner, he is tormented by his doomed relationships with prostitute Marie Charlet and sympathetic model Myriamme. (Biography) - 1952

programme.title: Stolen Hours
programme.desc: Laura (Susan Hayward), an American heiress in London, is a party girl living it up, in denial of her serious illness. She rebuffs the concerns of her ex-lover (Edward Judd) and keeps her health a secret from her sister (Diane Baker). Eventually, John (Michael Craig), a handsome doctor, demands she get treatment, and Laura finally listens. Doctor and patient fall in love and move to a house on the Cornish coast. In her dying days, the restless heiress searches for humility, happiness and peace. (Drama) - 1963

programme.title: Wild Gypsies
programme.desc: A vengeful outcast begins raping and killing the women of a Gypsy clan. (Drama) - 1969

programme.title: Melody Parade
programme.desc: An ambitious busboy (Eddie Quillan) and a nightclub owner (Tim Ryan) facing bankruptcy mistake a performer for a potential sponsor. (Musical) - 1943

programme.title: Happy Anniversary
programme.desc: On their 13th wedding anniversary, long-simmering tensions between Manhattan businessman Chris Walters (David Niven) and his homemaker wife, Alice (Mitzi Gaynor), explode with the arrival of a new television set from Alice's well-meaning but meddlesome parents (Loring Smith, Phyllis Povah). Tired of Chris's explosive temper and embarrassed by his drunken admission to her parents that they had been intimate prior to their wedding night, Alice debates leaving her husband. (Comedy) - 1959

programme.title: Adventures of Kitty O'Day
programme.desc: Kitty O'Day (Jean Parker) is a switchboard operator at a busy hotel where her boyfriend, Johnny (Peter Cookson), also works. Suspicious about some strange noises, she sends Johnny to her employer's apartment, where Johnny finds the boss has been murdered. Kitty is determined to find the culprit, but the hotheaded Inspector Clancy (Tim Ryan) is also on the case, and, as more bodies pile up at the hotel, the police start to throw accusations at Kitty and her amateur crime-solving crew. (Mystery) - 1944

programme.title: Ladybug, Ladybug
programme.desc: The teachers and students of a countryside elementary school are thrown into a panic when an air raid siren goes off, warning them of an imminent nuclear attack. They are unaware that it has gone off by mistake, and separate the children into groups -- one of which is headed by the anxious Mrs. Andrews (Nancy Marchand) -- to take them home. Harriet (Alice Playten) invites her classmates into her family's bomb shelter, but tragedy strikes when she won't allow one of her classmates to enter. (Drama) - 1963

programme.title: Wild in the Streets
programme.desc: Archetypal 1960s musician Max Frost (Christopher Jones) lends his backing to a Senate candidate who wants to give 18-year-olds the right to vote, but he takes things a step further than expected. Inspired by their hero's words, Max's fans pressure their leaders into extending the vote to citizens as young as 15. Max and his followers capitalize on their might by bringing new issues to the fore, but, drunk on power, they soon take generational warfare to terrible extremes. (Comedy) - 1968

Also joining the team is Patty Tolan, a lifelong New Yorker who knows the city inside and out.
